We're looking for an experienced design manager to lead our Product Design team.

This is a management role. Your job is to develop designers, raise the quality of the work, and make sure design has real influence on where the product goes. It is not a player-coach role, and it is not a step up for a strong IC looking for their first management position. We need someone who has already managed product designers and can do it well from day one.

n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems your team tackles are complex. Design decisions have to account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes ripple across the whole platform. You'll need enough craft depth to recognise excellent work, challenge it constructively, and help designers get better. The team needs a manager whose design judgment they trust.

You'll manage a team spanning product designers, design engineers and user researchers at a range of seniority levels, working across our product areas. You'll work alongside our other design manager. You'll report to our VP of Product until our Head of Design joins the team. That search is running now.

More than 80% of workflows built on n8n involve AI agents, and we're widening from a developer audience to a broader set of builders. That shift is the central design problem here, and your team is at the centre of it.

🎯 Your main goal is to build a Product Design team that consistently produces excellent work and shapes how n8n's product evolves. Here's what that involves:



LEAD AND DEVELOP THE TEAM

 - Run regular, high-quality 1:1s and coach designers, design engineers and researchers across different levels.

 - Own performance management: evidence-based reviews, honest feedback, and real support for anyone who isn't where they need to be.

 - Help people understand what's expected at their level and what growth looks like, evolving our progression framework for Product Design.

 - Hire excellent designers as the team grows, and broaden the range of backgrounds and perspectives on the team.


RAISE THE DESIGN BAR

 - Set and hold a high standard across problem framing, user understanding, interaction design, information architecture and visual craft.

 - Facilitate design critiques and reviews that measurably improve the work, and help designers think beyond the feature in front of them.

 - Develop designers' judgment and autonomy rather than becoming the final approval layer for every decision.


OWN THE WHOLE PRODUCT EXPERIENCE

 - Keep a holistic view across features and product areas, identifying inconsistencies, recurring UX problems, and opportunities for more coherent patterns.

 - Work with the team to address fragmentation systematically rather than feature by feature.


MAKE DESIGN A REAL PARTNER

 - Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership so design contributes early to problem definition and product direction, not late to execution.

 - Help designers influence product decisions through strong reasoning rather than positional authority.

 - Improve how the team works across critique, collaboration, decision-making and knowledge sharing, introducing structure where it helps the team scale and resisting process that slows things down.


HOW MUCH OF THIS IS HANDS-ON?

Worth being direct, because it's the question every good candidate asks. This is a management role: developing designers, raising the bar, and making design count in product decisions is the job, and that's where your time goes.

You'll stay close to the craft in critiques, in reviews and in the detail of the work, and you'll occasionally pick up design work yourself. When that happens it sits outside the squads and varies with the period: an exploratory concept, a gap during someone's leave, a problem that needs a first pass. It is not a 50/50 split, and if what you want is to keep a squad's worth of delivery alongside managing the team, this isn't the role.



REQUIREMENTS


MUST-HAVES

 - 👥 Proven design management: You've managed product designers in a product-led technology company for 3+ years, with a team of five or more. This is not a first management role.

 - 🧭 Running a team well: You've run effective 1:1s, evidence-based performance reviews and difficult feedback conversations, including with people who weren't performing. You've built or improved a career progression framework for designers, and you're comfortable with the administrative side of managing a team rather than treating it as overhead.

 - 📈 Growing people: You coach and mentor, you run critique that changes the work, and you can point to specific designers who got measurably better or grew in scope while reporting to you.

 - 🎨 Design taste and judgment: Your own craft is strong enough that designers trust your read on quality, you can articulate what separates adequate design from excellent design, and you'll step into the work directly when the situation calls for it.

 - 🎯 Hiring: You've hired designers consistently well, you know where good design talent is and how to attract it, and you can tell the difference quickly.

 - 🤖 AI fluency: You use AI tools hands-on in your own work and in how your team designs, and you have an informed view on designing AI-enabled products. AI agents are the product here, so this one is not optional.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - 🛠️ Technical products: You've managed design teams in B2B SaaS, developer tools, workflow automation or similarly technical products.

 - 🧠 Technical mindset: You don't need to write code, but genuine curiosity about what's happening underneath (APIs, webhooks, data structures, how workflows actually execute) earns you credibility with engineers here.

 - 👩‍💻 Designing for developers: You've designed products for developers, technical operators or other sophisticated users.

 - 🔭 Systems view: You can step back from individual projects to spot patterns and UX problems across a broader product experience.

 - 🤝 Influence without authority: You bring Product and Engineering peers with you through reasoning rather than positional authority.

 - 📊 Scaling teams: You've grown a design team through a period of rapid company growth.

 - 🌍 Distributed teams: You've managed designers in remote-first or highly distributed organisations.

 - 🔓 Open source: You've worked on open-source or community-driven products.

 - 🌱 Inclusive hiring: You've meaningfully broadened the diversity of a design team through how you hire.
   


OUR HIRING PROCESS

We'll tell you the whole shape of it upfront, and there's very little homework.

 1. Screening call with our recruiter. 45 minutes, no prep.

 2. Leading designers with the hiring manager, 75 minutes. You'll present for 20 minutes on a team you built, grew or turned around. Reuse existing material; it shouldn't take more than two or three hours. We don't need case studies of your own design work.

 3. Live critique and coaching, 60 minutes. We'll send you a real piece of n8n design work 24 hours ahead. You'll critique it, then have a coaching conversation with the designer who made it. No preparation beyond reading it and trying the product.

 4. Conversation with our VP of Product, and a culture call with Jan, our CEO. 45 minutes each, same day where we can.

 5. Meet two or three of the designers you'd be managing. Not scored; it's for you as much as for us.

We'll also ask for two references, one of them a former direct report. A portfolio is welcome if you have one, though we know not every design manager keeps theirs current.



WHY JOIN US?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into a slide deck. You'll lead design for a product that hundreds of thousands of builders use to automate real work, sitting right where developer tools, AI agents and no-code interaction models meet. The design problems are genuinely hard and largely unsolved.

You're inheriting an established team with strong designers, not building from zero, and there's real room to shape how the team coaches, critiques, grows and works with Product and Engineering, rather than inheriting a rigid design organisation. You'll stay close enough to the craft to influence quality directly, while your main job is making the designers around you better.

You'll join a fast-growing, Europe remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation, and craft matter, at the point where n8n is scaling from a beloved open-source project into a major B2B platform. Design's contribution to product thinking is established here, and has a long way still to run.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now and help us build the future of automation.

Your main goal will be to make it simple and reliable for customers to buy, pay for, and grow their use of n8n. You'll own the foundations of how n8n's commercial system works: licensing and entitlements, customer accounts, and the metering and billing platform for both Cloud and Enterprise. Today these live across several teams and two billing stacks; you'll bring them into one stable home that the rest of the company builds on.



This is a foundations role. You build the system that pricing and packaging decisions run on, rather than running price experiments yourself. To do so, here are your core responsibilities:



OWN THE LICENSING & BILLING STRATEGY & ROADMAP

 - Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for Licensing & Billing in partnership with Engineering, Product leadership, Finance, and go-to-market.

 - Prioritize foundational investments based on revenue integrity, enterprise needs, data correctness, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs explicit.

 - Lead discovery with enterprise customers, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and RevOps to understand how n8n is bought, renewed, and grown today, and where that breaks.



LICENSING, ENTITLEMENTS & ACCOUNTS

 - Own the license server and entitlement model: issuance, renewal, and validation across Cloud, self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments, with one source of truth for which plan or deal grants which features.

 - Introduce "account" as a first-class product primitive (accounts, purchases, license keys, activations) and expose it as the API contract our customer-facing console and multi-instance management are built on.

 - Productize the deal-to-entitlement flow so a closed deal in Salesforce creates or updates entitlements without manual steps.



METERING & BILLING PLATFORM

 - Own usage metering and billing for Cloud and Enterprise, including subscription billing: what counts as a billable execution, quota consumption, and overage charging.

 - Lead the migration off Paddle Classic and unify Cloud and Enterprise billing into one platform.

 - Build the mechanics for usage-based enterprise billing and reliable overage charging.



CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

 - Make the architecture and mechanism decisions (entitlement model, billing platform, enterprise invoicing path) and align closely with Finance and go-to-market on each of them. Every decision here touches money; you bring people along rather than inform them afterwards.

 - Hold clear boundaries with adjacent teams: the customer console, execution limits, and access control live elsewhere; you own the data and mechanics they rely on.

 - Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.




REQUIREMENTS



Must-haves

 - Billing or licensing product experience: You have 6+ years in Product, with a substantial part spent owning a billing, licensing, entitlement, or quote-to-cash system at a B2B SaaS company.

 - Shipped through Finance and RevOps: You've driven a cross-functional systems change where Finance, Sales Ops, and Engineering all had a say, and you got it live.

 - Systems and data-model depth: You can design or critique an entity model, reason about reconciliation and idempotency in a sync, read an API contract, and explain why two systems reading the same events end up with different numbers.

 - Attention to detail: You know that if the billing data is wrong, everything built on it inherits the error, and you sequence work accordingly.

 - Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or data-quality work to commercial outcomes.

 - Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

 - Exceptional communication: You're equally at home with engineers, the Finance team, and Sales, and you can make billing trade-offs legible to all of them.

 - Enterprise reality: You understand what self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments mean for licensing and metering.



Nice-to-haves

 - Usage-based billing: You've owned usage-based or hybrid (subscription plus usage) billing.

 - Vendor billing stacks: You've worked hands-on with Paddle, Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora or similar, and know where they break at enterprise contract volume.

 - Migration experience: You've run a billing-provider migration.

 - Hands-on ability: You can read code, query data, or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

 - CRM integration: You've worked on Salesforce or CRM-to-billing integrations.

 - Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, agent orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

 - Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.



Why join us?



At n8n, you'll be in the middle of the AI revolution. The shift from deterministic automation to agent autonomy is a genuinely open design space, and n8n has a credible claim to owning it. Every plan we sell, every enterprise contract, and every agent run that gets metered and billed runs on the foundation you own: licensing, entitlements, accounts, and the billing platform across Cloud and Enterprise. Your work directly shapes how n8n makes money and how easily customers can buy, grow, and trust what they pay for, from self-serve Cloud to air-gapped and OEM deployments.

You'll join one of Europe's fastest growing startups at the sweet spot: small enough to have real impact and be empowered, big enough that your work already reaches massive scale and serious enterprise customers. You'll work with experienced engineers, Finance, and go-to-market on problems where the details are the product, in an AI-native, empowered culture of humble, kind, yet driven and direct people, where you're hired to think, not just to execute. And with our fair-code model, a passionate open-source community gives you a direct feedback loop on everything you ship.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now, and help us build the commercial foundation of the future of reliable AI automation.

STAFF PLATFORM ENGINEER, AGENTIC ENGINEERING

Developer Productivity · AI Coding Agents · Developer Platform

Our ambition: an engineering organisation where humans and agents work as one continuously learning system, turning frontier AI capabilities and real-world feedback into more ambitious product development. We want n8n to be the reference for how this is done, without compromising quality, resilience or trust. Your main goal is to make that real.



This is a Staff individual contributor role in Developer Platform and the technical driving force behind ACDC (Agent-centric Development Cycle), our engineering-wide initiative for agentic development. Nobody has a playbook for this yet. You'll write ours.



You won't start from zero. Agents wired into Linear already automate around 80% of the development cycle on one of our developer platform projects, alongside pilots for insight, feature-flag and PR-review agents and a shared agent harness. Your job is to take this from promising experiments to the way n8n builds software.



This role is for someone who thinks about this problem constantly. You run agents all day, rebuild your own workflow every time the frontier moves, and have more ideas than time. 



You'll stay hands-on, building the first versions yourself, and shape how the work grows beyond one person.




WHAT YOU'LL DO


SET DIRECTION AND OWN THE OUTCOME

 - Identify where agentic development can make the greatest difference, using developer feedback, existing experiments and engineering performance data.

 - Set the strategy and priorities across agent execution, repository readiness, CI, security and developer workflows.

 - Make build, buy or pass decisions on tools and vendors, and own the cost and value trade-offs, including AI spend.

 - Make decisions where requirements are incomplete and the trade-offs between autonomy, reliability, security and review effort are still emerging.

 - Build alignment through technical proposals, clear decisions and working software, and report progress and impact to engineering leadership.


BUILD THE FOUNDATIONS

 - Design and build isolated execution environments where agents can work with the right access to code, tools and context, without exposing secrets or sensitive systems.

 - Own the safety model: which task categories agents may attempt, what they must never touch, and where human review is required, partnering with Security on sensitive areas like auth, billing, permissions and data handling.

 - Make n8n's monorepo agent-ready, working with Architecture and senior engineers on repo structure, testability, boundaries and the context agents need.


INTEGRATE AGENTS INTO HOW WE WORK

 - Build repeatable workflows that take Linear issues through agent execution, self-verification and review to merged PRs, across a growing range of task types.

 - Integrate agentic workflows with GitHub, CI, test infrastructure and code review, so the agentic path becomes the easiest path for engineers.

 - Extend the loop beyond coding: connect earlier signals like product research and customer requests, and later ones like production metrics, so agents contribute across the whole cycle.

 - Open it up beyond engineering, so PMs, designers and others can turn a well-defined issue into a reviewed, mergeable change.

 - Shape review practices, such as PR evidence that shows what changed, what ran, what risks remain and where human judgment is needed.


MEASURE WHAT WORKS

 - Build benchmarks from real historical engineering tasks to evaluate output quality, failure modes, review burden and production risk.

 - Define and track quality and adoption signals, such as reviewer acceptance rate, CI pass rate, rework rate and developer satisfaction.

 - Use data and feedback to change course, retire what doesn't work, and build trust across engineering.


REQUIREMENTS


MUST-HAVES

 - 🔥 Frontier obsession: You live at the frontier. You try new models and tools as they land, and you have strong, evidence-backed opinions on what's real and what's hype.

 - 🧭 Staff-scope ownership: You’ve led complex platform, DevEx or engineering productivity initiatives across teams, from defining the problem to sustained adoption and measurable impact, where there was no established approach to follow.

 - 🤖 Agentic depth: You use coding agents daily as a power user, and you've built infrastructure around them, such as repo context and instructions, tool or MCP integrations, sandboxed execution or agent workflows in CI, that other engineers rely on.

 - 🎯 Product mindset for internal platforms: You treat engineers as your customers. You start from real friction, prioritise by impact, make build-vs-buy calls, weigh cost against value, and let adoption tell you whether something works.

 - 🤝 Direction without authority: You've set technical direction that multiple teams followed, through proposals, design reviews and credibility with senior engineers across Platform, Product Engineering, AI, Security and Architecture.

 - 🔐 Safety judgment: You've made real decisions on permissions, secrets, sandboxing, sensitive code paths and human-in-the-loop review, and can explain the trade-offs.

 - 📊 Measurement that drives decisions: You've built evaluations, benchmarks or quality metrics and used them to change course or retire things that didn't work. You care about outcomes, not lines of AI-generated code.

 - ✍️ Writing that changes decisions: Your technical proposals and documentation have shifted what teams did.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - 📦 TypeScript monorepos: You have worked in a large TypeScript, Node.js or JavaScript monorepo.

 - ⚙️ Developer platforms: You have experience with GitHub Actions, Linear, test infrastructure, preview environments or internal developer platforms.

 - 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Growing a team: You've mentored engineers or helped shape a new team as an initiative grew beyond one person.

 - 🌍 Open-source communities: You have contributed to open-source or source-available projects with active developer communities.

 - 🏢 B2B SaaS context: You understand environments where reliability, permissions, data handling and customer trust are central.

 - 🔗 Workflow automation: You're familiar with workflow automation, integration platforms, AI orchestration or developer-facing products.




WHY JOIN US?

At n8n, you'll define how autonomous AI agents become a trusted part of engineering inside one of Europe's fastest-growing AI-native infrastructure companies. Your work will shape the platform foundations, safety model, evaluation framework and developer workflows that decide whether agents can contribute meaningfully to production engineering without lowering the quality bar.

You'll join a remote-first team with high autonomy, high visibility and a strong builder mindset. Because this is a first-of-its-kind role, you'll set direction, influence engineering culture, and create learnings that may inform both our internal engineering and n8n's product thinking.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now, and help us build the future of automation.

We are early. The strategic motion is new, and you will shape it alongside a small group of senior sellers and n8n leadership. If you are looking for a fully built territory and a playbook to follow, this is not it. If you want to be one of the people who builds it, read on:


OWN A NAMED PORTFOLIO

 - Build multi-year account plans that map business units, regions, executive sponsors and use cases across large, multi-company groups.

 - Find where n8n already runs inside your accounts and turn that bottom-up adoption into executive-sponsored, company-wide programmes.

 - Lead hiring, onboarding, and team development to build a strong, collaborative engineering team as n8n scales.


DRIVE EXECUTION AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ALIGNMENT

 - Partner with Product, Design, and other stakeholders to align priorities, navigate trade-offs, and deliver meaningful product and platform outcomes.

At n8n, your impact will go far beyond managing delivery. You'll lead a team at the heart of our enterprise ambitions, shaping the integrations and strategic partnerships that make n8n a trusted automation platform for businesses worldwide. You'll join a fast-growing, remote-first company with a strong builder culture, an ambitious vision for AI-native automation, and a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders. We value technical excellence, ownership, experimentation, and leaders who help others do their best work.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of enterprise automation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Your mission: drive ARR growth by turning hundreds (soon thousands) of n8n agency partners into a demand engine through scaled marketing programs.

Our agency partner network includes automation specialists and small consultancies with most ranging from 1–50 people. They leverage n8n to help their customers automate and transform their business - they have technical skills and customer knowledge but most have limited marketing resources.

The goal for this position is to define, build and launch creative marketing programs that our agency partners can utilize to grow their business with n8n. This will include building scalable self-serve programs (one to many) as well as working with some of the larger agency partners on specific marketing programs (one to one). Here’s an overview of what this position will be responsible for: 

Build the program portfolio - Drive adoption

 - Work directly with the agency partner marketing managers to define the overall strategy - what playbooks, what investments, what markets etc.

 - Ship ready-to-run programs: Event-in-a-Box kits for local workshops and seminars, email and social campaigns, industry-specific use-case campaigns, reusable customer stories and simple demand-gen playbooks.

 - Make every program executable without help: clear steps, editable templates and localisable assets that work for a solo consultant and a 50-person agency, in any region.

 - Drive awareness and adoption of the various marketing programs through scaled and creative communications.

Measure and multiply

 - Track the full funnel from access to download, execution, customer opportunities and revenue — for partners and for n8n.

 - Use partner feedback and performance data to decide what to scale, what to change and what to stop.

 - Turn each working program into a repeatable model for the next one, and automate your own program operations with n8n where it saves time.

 - Measure the overall business impact and growth from agency partner generated business.
   
   

Requirements 

Must-have

 - Partner marketing at scale: You've built one-to-many programs adopted by hundreds or thousands of partners, and can show adoption numbers

 - Self-service program design: You've packaged marketing so non-marketers can run it (kits, templates, playbooks) and know what makes them get used rather than downloaded

 - Small-business empathy: You understand how small consultancies work and design for their limited time, budget and marketing know-how

 - Outcome-driven measurement: You measure execution and pipeline, not asset views, and you're comfortable stopping a program that isn't working

 - Bias for action: You're happy as a first hire with limited design and development support; you ship a pilot quickly and improve it with real data

 - Global mindset: You've run programs across several regions and segments, and know how to localise without rebuilding from scratch

 

Nice-to-have

 - Strategic partner programs: You've also built custom marketing programs with large partners that ran over several months or quarters

 - Channel or ecosystem background: You've worked on an agency, solutions-partner or reseller program at a software company

 - Hands-on with automation: You've built workflows yourself — in n8n or similar tools — and can talk shop with technical partners

 - Local events: You've designed field events or workshops that others delivered

 - Languages: You work professionally in a language beyond English

LEAD, COACH & DEVELOP A HIGH-PERFORMING TEAM

You will own retention and expansion for your accounts, running a tight operating cadence of kickoffs, success plans, health checks, QBRs and renewals, while proactively managing risk and escalations.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Build an account strategy for each customer and a footprint across their organization, from IT and engineering teams to senior business and executive stakeholders

🌱 Builder mindset: You enjoy taking ownership and making an impact in fast-changing environments 


Nice-to-haves

🎯 Your main goal will be to identify and reduce security risks across n8n's product and internal systems, using threat modelling, hands-on security expertise, and cross-functional collaboration to help teams design, build, and operate more secure systems.

You'll join our growing security team at a pivotal stage, acting as a trusted security partner to teams across the business. You'll help us build a move from reactive security management to a proactive, scalable security practice.

Here's what you'll be driving:


THREAT MODELLING, RISK ASSESSMENT & SECURITY DESIGN

 - Conduct threat modelling and risk assessments across product features, AI agents, cloud infrastructure, corporate IT, internal applications, and data systems, identifying vulnerabilities and recommending practical mitigations.

 - Partner with Engineering, Cloud, IT, and Data teams to review security designs, define actionable security requirements, and influence the implementation of appropriate controls.

 - Help teams embed security into their development processes through secure coding guidance, design reviews, documentation, and security tooling that enables them to identify and address risks independently.


VULNERABILITY MANAGEMENT & COORDINATED DISCLOSURE

 - Participate in the security triage rotation, assessing incoming vulnerability reports, validating findings, and prioritising remediation based on severity and business impact.

 - Collaborate with engineering teams to coordinate vulnerability remediation, verify fixes, and support secure patch and release processes.

 - Help manage our vulnerability disclosure and bug bounty programmes, including engagement with security researchers, coordinated disclosures, and GitHub Security Advisories.


SECURITY OPERATIONS & INCIDENT READINESS

 - Help establish and improve logging, detection, and protective monitoring capabilities across our infrastructure, corporate systems, and internal applications.

 - Develop and improve incident response processes, runbooks, and exercises to strengthen our ability to detect, investigate, and respond to security incidents.

 - Work closely with system owners to identify security gaps, prioritise remediation, and verify that implemented controls effectively reduce risk.


CUSTOMER TRUST & COMPLIANCE ENGINEERING

 - Support SOC 2 compliance by helping establish continuous control monitoring, automated evidence collection, and processes that make security assurance part of everyday operations.

 - Collaborate with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to respond to customer security assessments and build reusable resources that streamline future requests.

 - Partner with Legal, Finance, IT, and other stakeholders to assess security risks, improve security policies and controls, and strengthen trust with enterprise customers.

We're hiring two Security Engineers with complementary strengths, so you don't need to be an expert in every security domain. 


REQUIREMENTS


MUST-HAVES

 - 🔍 Threat Modelling & Risk Assessment: You have hands-on experience assessing real-world systems, identifying security risks, determining defensible severity levels, and recommending practical controls that teams can implement.

 - 🛠️ Technical Security Expertise: You can validate security findings, reproduce vulnerabilities, develop proof-of-concepts, and write code or automation when needed to demonstrate risks or improve security processes.

 - 🔐 Security Engineering Experience: You've worked hands-on in infrastructure, product, or application security within a product-focused organisation, with a strong understanding of how modern systems are designed and secured.

 - 🤝 Cross-functional Influence: You're comfortable acting as an internal security consultant, advising teams, challenging technical decisions constructively, and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

 - 🎯 Risk Remediation & Ownership: You've helped secure systems you don't directly own, translating security findings into actionable requirements and working with responsible teams to ensure effective remediation.

 - 🤖 AI & LLM Fluency: You're comfortable using LLM-assisted tooling and understand its limitations, security implications, and potential failure modes.

 - ✍️ Clear Communication: You can explain complex security risks, document technical findings, and provide practical guidance that engineers and non-technical stakeholders can confidently act on.

You also bring deep expertise in at least two of the following areas:

 - 💻 Application Security: You've developed security checks, engineering guardrails, tooling, or guidance that helps product teams build and ship secure software.

 - ☁️ Platform Security: You have experience securing a major cloud provider and Kubernetes environments, including areas such as sandboxing, multi-tenancy, or identity.

 - 🔑 Corporate Security: You've worked on identity and access management, endpoint security, employee access lifecycles, or data access controls across corporate environments.

 - 🚨 Security Monitoring: You've implemented logging, protective monitoring, or security detection capabilities that support effective investigation and incident response.

 - 📋 Security Assurance & Compliance: You've supported SOC 2 or ISO 27001 from an engineering perspective, including implementing technical controls or automating compliance evidence collection.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - 🐛 Vulnerability Disclosure: You've helped operate bug bounty or coordinated vulnerability disclosure programmes, including publishing security advisories such as GHSAs or CVEs.

 - 🧠 AI & Agent Security: You have experience assessing or securing LLM-powered applications and AI agents, including risks related to permissions, tool access, prompt injection, or sensitive data.

 - 🏢 Corporate IT Tooling: You're familiar with platforms such as Okta, Azure, or Drata and their role in securing corporate systems and supporting compliance.

 - 🌍 Open-source Ecosystems: You've worked with open-source or source-available products, contributed to security communities, or are already familiar with n8n.

 - 🎯 Penetration Testing: You have practical penetration testing experience and can independently identify, demonstrate, and help remediate security vulnerabilities.

 - 🌱 Early-stage Security Experience: You've been an early security hire or helped establish security practices in a startup or rapidly scaling organisation.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll help shape security at a defining stage of our growth. We're building a security practice that goes beyond reacting to vulnerabilities, and you'll play a key role in how we identify risks, influence engineering decisions, and establish security practices that scale with the business.

You'll work across a broad range of challenges, from securing AI-powered product features and our source-available automation platform to improving corporate security, strengthening incident readiness, and making compliance more automated. You'll have direct exposure to teams across the company, the opportunity to influence important technical decisions, and the autonomy to turn your expertise into measurable security improvements.



Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of secure automation.

🎯 Your main goal will be to own and help build a scalable renewal motion for our Scaled Customer Success segment: protecting revenue and ensuring contracts reach a signed outcome ahead of expiry.

As our dedicated Renewals Specialist in North America, you’ll manage the end-to-end commercial renewal process for a high-volume portfolio of Enterprise customers, typically €20k–50k ARR, with around 60 renewals per quarter. You’ll work closely with our Scaled CSMs while helping us build the processes, operating rhythms, and automation that will allow renewals to scale as n8n grows. You'll usually work with billing/procurement contacts and the n8n champion on the account (often a technical user or engineer). 




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own renewals end-to-end. Prepare and send renewal quotes, negotiate pricing and commercial terms, manage procurement and contractual back-and-forth, create order forms, coordinate signatures, and ensure completed contracts are accurately processed in our CRM and billing systems.

 - Manage a high-volume renewal pipeline. Keep around 60 renewals per quarter progressing with clear next steps, accurate renewal dates, and enough lead time to avoid preventable last-minute slippage.

 - Partner with CSMs on renewal risk. Work closely with Scaled CSMs to understand customer health, identify potential churn or commercial risk early, and determine the right path to renewal.

 - Keep the forecast accurate. Maintain reliable renewal forecasts, close-plan notes, and CRM hygiene so we have a clear view of upcoming renewals and revenue retention.

 - Build a more scalable renewal motion. Identify where processes break down or create unnecessary manual work, and improve the workflows, templates, operating rhythms, and automation behind them.

 - Navigate the business independently. Partner with Finance, Legal, Sales, and Customer Success to resolve commercial or contractual blockers and keep renewals moving.




REQUIREMENTS


MUST-HAVES

 - 🔄 B2B SaaS renewals experience: You’ve owned commercial renewals, account management, or a commercially focused Customer Success portfolio in B2B SaaS, including negotiating contracts and renewals with business customers.

 - 📚 High-volume portfolio management: You’ve managed a sizeable book of customers and are comfortable keeping dozens of commercial conversations moving simultaneously. Experience with smaller Enterprise accounts and roughly €20k–50k ARR contracts is particularly relevant.

 - 🤝 Commercial & contractual confidence: You’re comfortable negotiating pricing and terms and navigating the practical mechanics of SaaS renewals — quotes, order forms, procurement, legal review, approvals, and signatures.

 - 📈 Operational rigor: You manage your renewal pipeline with discipline. Forecasts, dates, next steps, and CRM data stay accurate, and you take ownership of getting contracts closed on time.

 - 🚀 High-growth startup experience: You’ve worked in a fast-growing environment where processes change quickly, ownership is high, and the answer isn't always already documented.

 - 🛠️ Builder mindset: You don't just execute a process — you notice where it isn't working and help improve it. You’re comfortable creating structure while doing the work at the same time.

 - 🤖 Automation mindset: You’re interested in using automation and AI to eliminate repetitive work and make high-volume processes more scalable.




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - ⚡ Scaled Customer Success experience: You’ve worked in a high-volume or scaled CS/renewals model before.

 - 🏢 Exposure to a mature renewals function: You’ve seen what strong renewal processes look like at a larger SaaS company and can bring some of those learnings into an earlier-stage environment.

 - 🛠️ Relevant tooling: Experience with CRM, CS, or renewals tooling such as Salesforce, Gainsight, or similar.

 - 🤖 n8n experience: You’ve used n8n or another workflow automation platform and are excited about what automation can do.
   
   


WHY JOIN US?

At n8n, you won’t be stepping into a fully established renewal function - you’ll help create it.

Our Scaled Customer Success team is still relatively new, while the number of customers and renewals we manage is growing quickly. As our first dedicated renewals hire for this segment, you’ll have real influence over how we structure the renewal process, what we automate, and how we manage retention efficiently as we scale.

This is an opportunity to combine hands-on commercial ownership with building something from the ground up. You’ll work closely with Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and Legal, and you'll be able to see the direct impact of your work on our customers and revenue.

We’re particularly interested in using AI and automation to scale the function without simply adding more headcount, so if you enjoy finding smarter ways to eliminate repetitive work and improve processes, you’ll have plenty of room to experiment.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on? Apply now and help us build the renewal motion that will support n8n’s next stage of growth.

🎯 Your main goal will be to own the forward-looking financial plan for the top and mid funnel of n8n’s commercial engine, helping Marketing leadership make sharper investment decisions across both our PLG and SLG motions.

To do so, you’ll turn demand, funnel, and marketing investment decisions into an integrated financial view that leadership can act on:


OWN MARKETING PLANNING & FORECASTING

 - Drive n8n’s annual planning and regular forecasting process for Marketing end to end, from top-down targets and cross-functional alignment through regional segmentation, budget ownership, and consolidation into the company plan.

 - Partner with Marketing budget owners across demand generation, brand, community and DevRel, product marketing, and events to set budgets, forecast spend, and sharpen investment trade-offs.

 - Own program spend with the same rigor as headcount, including agency and media contracts, event and sponsorship commitments, phasing, seasonality, and in-year reallocations.


MODEL FUNNEL & CHANNEL ECONOMICS

 - Model demand creation, signup and MQL volume, activation, qualified opportunity, conversion, and velocity with Marketing Ops and RevOps across both PLG and SLG motions.

 - Translate funnel and channel levers into the demand assumptions behind n8n’s integrated top-line model and quantify the financial impact and trade-offs of changing them.

 - Assess CAC and payback, conversion, pipeline contribution, and expected versus realized ROI using attribution, incrementality testing, and other causal methods where appropriate.


BUILD A RIGOROUS MARKETING INVESTMENT FRAMEWORK

 - Establish a repeatable process for material marketing bets covering hypothesis, baseline, expected return, confidence range, leading indicators, scale-or-stop triggers, and post-investment review.

 - Build and defend investment cases for brand, community, content, events, and other spend that does not attribute cleanly to closed revenue.

 - Use internal evidence, external benchmarks, and post-investment learnings to drive in-year reallocations toward the highest-impact opportunities.


TURN DATA INTO DECISIONS

 - Partner with Marketing Ops, RevOps, Data, and Controlling to keep the financial view aligned with n8n’s attribution, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

 - Own the financial metric definitions behind Marketing reporting and ensure teams are operating from a consistent view of performance.

 - Turn financial reporting and variance analysis into tangible insights and recommendations for Marketing leadership, executives, and board-level audiences when needed.


REQUIREMENTS


MUST-HAVES

 - 📊 FP&A experience: You have 7+ years of experience in FP&A or strategic finance, ideally in a fast-paced technology or B2B SaaS environment.

 - 🗂️ Complex planning experience: You have led complex, multi-entity, multi-stakeholder annual planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes end to end.

 - 🤝 Marketing business partnering: You have deep demand-side finance partnering experience in either a self-serve/PLG funnel or an enterprise/SLG demand generation motion, plus a strong working understanding of the other.

 - 📈 Funnel and channel economics: You are fluent in CAC and CAC payback by channel and motion, blended versus paid CAC, CLV/CAC, pipeline attribution, funnel conversion, and velocity.

 - 🧭 Judgment on unattributable spend: You have built and defended investment cases for brand, community, content, or similar spend that will never attribute cleanly to a closed deal.

 - 💶 Program spend ownership: You are comfortable owning a budget weighted toward program spend, including commitments, phasing, agency costs, vendor economics, and reallocations.

 - 🧮 Financial modeling: You build sophisticated, integrated financial models that remain robust as assumptions, scenarios, and operating inputs change.

 - 🗣️ Executive communication: You translate complex analysis into clear recommendations and are comfortable presenting to Marketing leadership, executives, and board audiences when needed.

 - 🤖 AI- and automation-first mindset: You naturally use AI and automation platforms such as n8n to improve the quality, speed, and repeatability of your planning, reporting, and analysis.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - 🔄 PLG + SLG fluency: You have deep experience across both product-led and sales-led demand motions rather than primarily one.

 - 🧑‍💻 Developer-focused environment: You have worked at a community-led, open-source, or developer-focused product company.

 - 🧪 Incrementality & experimentation: You have exposure to incrementality testing, holdout design, or marketing mix modeling.

 - 🛠️ Marketing & RevOps tooling: You have experience consuming data from tools such as HubSpot or Marketo, GA4, attribution platforms, and Salesforce.

 - 📋 Planning platforms: You have worked with financial or headcount planning platforms such as Pigment in complex, multi-entity, or multi-stakeholder environments.

 - 🧑‍🔬 Data self-sufficiency: You are comfortable using SQL and building your own views in tools such as Looker, Metabase, or Hex rather than waiting on a Data team.

🎯 Your main goal will be to build and ship end-to-end TypeScript product features that make n8n safer, more scalable, and more programmable for enterprise customers — helping large organizations run business-critical automation with confidence.

To do so, you’ll own outcomes across the full stack and stay close to users, product, security, and enterprise-scale requirements:


ENTERPRISE PRODUCT OWNERSHIP

 - Own product surfaces from discovery to delivery across areas like identity, access, governance, APIs, observability, environments, and enterprise integrations.

 - Ship high-quality features fast across the TypeScript stack, balancing usability, security, performance, and maintainability.

 - Partner closely with Product to translate complex enterprise customer needs into clear scopes, technical trade-offs, and measurable outcomes.


FULLSTACK DELIVERY ACROSS PLATFORM AND PRODUCT

 - Build and evolve customer-facing experiences in Vue or React for admins, developers, and enterprise users managing n8n at scale.

 - Develop scalable Node.js services and APIs that power authentication, permissions, workflow lifecycle management, observability, integrations, and partner use cases.

 - Move fluidly between frontend and backend codebases to unblock your team and keep momentum high across complex product areas.


SECURE, SCALABLE ENTERPRISE FOUNDATIONS

 - Build capabilities that help organizations control who can do what across n8n, including authentication, provisioning, RBAC, credential infrastructure, and secrets management.

 - Contribute to safe workflow delivery through environments, source control, versioning, testing, CI/CD validation, and deployment workflows.

 - Improve governance, observability, auditability, and runtime controls so admins can understand, troubleshoot, and enforce how n8n is used.


APIS, INTEGRATIONS, AND EXTENSIBILITY

 - Build and maintain enterprise-grade integrations, nodes, SDK capabilities, and execution patterns that support automation at scale.

 - Design APIs, embed capabilities, and multi-instance management features that make n8n programmable for partners, developers, and large customers.

 - Instrument features end-to-end so you can measure impact, debug real-world behavior, and continuously improve reliability for business-critical workflows.


TEAMS YOU COULD JOIN

We’re currently hiring across multiple enterprise product engineering teams, including IAM, Enterprise Nodes, API & OEM, and Governance & Observability. During the interview process you’ll be matched to a team based on your strengths and what you’re most excited to build.

 - Learn more about the teams and their focus areas here https://app.notion.com/p/Discover-Engineering-n8n-1b65b6e0c94f80688f43d9bbc76023c3?pvs=21.


REQUIREMENTS


MUST-HAVES

 - 🧩 Fullstack JavaScript/TypeScript experience: You’ve shipped customer-facing features using TypeScript across frontend and backend, and you feel comfortable working fullstack.

 - 🧠 Product-minded engineering: You talk about users, workflows, and outcomes rather than only implementation details, and you enjoy turning complex customer problems into simple product experiences.

 - Prospect across channels: Engage prospects through email, phone, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.

 - Lead early-stage discovery: Understand business needs, technical environments, priorities, urgency and potential fit with n8n.

 - Continuously improve: Use Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo, AI tools, coaching and performance data to sharpen your approach.

 - Experience generating pipeline through outbound prospecting within mid- market or enterprise accounts

 - Confidence engaging senior business and technical stakeholders

 - A thoughtful approach to account research, personalisation and qualification

 - Curiosity about technical products, automation and AI

 - Resilience, consistency and ownership of your results

 - The ability to work from our London office three days per week

Success here is about quality, not just activity.

 - Create outreach that gets attention: Develop thoughtful, personalized messaging tied to real account priorities rather than generic sequences.

 - Prospect across channels: Engage prospects through email, phone, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.

 - Lead early-stage discovery: Understand business needs, technical environments, priorities, urgency and potential fit with n8n.

 - Continuously improve: Use Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo, AI tools, coaching and performance data to sharpen your approach.

 - SDR or BDR experience in B2B SaaS, software or technology

 - Experience generating pipeline through outbound prospecting into mid- market or enterprise accounts

 - Strong sales track record against your targets

 - Confidence engaging senior business and technical stakeholders

 - A thoughtful approach to account research, personalization and qualification

 - Curiosity about technical products, automation and AI

 - Resilience, consistency and ownership of your results

 - The ability to work from our Boston office three days per week

Success here is about quality, not just activity.

You’ll build a deep understanding of your accounts, identify the right stakeholders, create messaging that earns attention and generate qualified enterprise opportunities that can turn into meaningful revenue.

 - Partner with others in the Legal team on privacy questions that arise in product design.

 - Support Product and Engineering with customer, community and regulator questions about how our products meet legal requirements.
   
   

Support complex technology and commercial deals (c. 20% of the role)

 - Review, draft and negotiate technology-heavy agreements (SaaS and self-hosted), partnership and integration, and AI model and cloud provider contracts.

 - Partner with sales, partnerships and revenue teams on complex enterprise deals with AI or product requirements.

 - Deliver creative, risk-based solutions that protect the business, and feed deal learnings back into product decisions.
   
   

Scale legal as a business enabler

 - Solve legal questions in real time with a builder mindset.

 - Improve and maintain scalable legal templates, playbooks and training materials together with the Legal team, so that standard deals and product questions do not need legal involvement, so the wider Legal team can run standard deals without escalation.

 - Collaborate with our Automation and Legal Operations to improve our self-serve legal processes and tooling.

 - ⚖️ Qualified lawyer (Europe-based): You are a qualified legal professional with 5+ years' post-qualification experience (PQE), with at least 3 of those years within an in-house SaaS or technology environment with a start up or scale up company.

 - 💬 Fluent English: You can clearly communicate legal nuance in plain terms to global stakeholders.

 - 🤖 Product, AI and digital regulation expert: You have substantial, hands-on experience of acting as a trusted business partner to and advising technology teams on regulatory matters such as the EU AI Act and related digital regulation and a clear track record of getting up to speed on new regulation quickly.

 - 🔓 Open-source and licensing: You have working knowledge of open-source, fair-code or open-core licensing and how it applies to software products.

 - 🌍 Cross-functional collaborator: You have experience supporting engineers, product managers and sales teams, and can demonstrate how you balance legal risk with product and revenue goals.

 - 🛠️ Builder mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity, enjoy solving problems with and without a playbook, and look for ways to improve how legal works.

 - 🏃 Fast-scaling environment experience: You have worked where priorities shift quickly and your impact is immediate.

 - 📄 Commercial and technology contracts: You have solid working experience with SaaS and self-hosted software license agreements.
   
   

Nice-to-haves

 - 🧠 Curiosity for tech and automation: You are excited to experiment with legal tech, AI tools and scalable internal systems.

DESIGN OUR INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE

 - Define the taxonomy, structure, contributor guidelines, and templates that turn fragmented company knowledge into reliable, reusable context.

 - Establish standards that make knowledge easy to navigate, maintain, and use without creating duplication or another layer of content sprawl.

 - Evolve these standards as our functions, knowledge sources, and agentic use cases grow.


ONBOARD & ENABLE TEAMS

 - Onboard functions to the company brain and train designated champions to structure and maintain their own knowledge over time.

 - Give non-technical contributors the guidance, templates, and support they need to contribute high-quality context independently.

 - Partner with the Internal AI Enablement Lead to develop a shared network of champions who help scale strong knowledge practices across n8n.


OPERATE OUR CONTEXT PLATFORM

 - Configure and operate ingestion from qualitative sources such as Slack, Gong, Drive, and Notion using our context platform’s tooling.

 - Own day-to-day platform configuration and basic troubleshooting, escalating genuine engineering challenges to our Automation team or vendor when needed.

 - Partner with IT, Security, and Legal to define requirements for how people and AI agents access sensitive company knowledge.


BUILD FOR LONG-TERM TRUST & REUSE

 - Keep content structures, contributor guidelines, and knowledge freshness current as n8n and the platform evolve.

 - Work with functions to ensure the company brain becomes a trusted source of context rather than another parallel knowledge repository.

 - Provide product feedback to our context platform vendor and anticipate shared context patterns and capabilities that future agents will need.

 - ⚙️ SaaS platform fluency: You’re comfortable configuring and operating SaaS knowledge or context platforms, working with APIs and integrations, and independently troubleshooting basic issues.

 - 🎓 Stakeholder enablement: You have a track record of training non-technical stakeholders and enabling them to confidently maintain high-quality content themselves over the long term.

 - 🔐 Governance collaboration: You’re comfortable partnering with IT, Security, and Legal on access requirements and compliance-sensitive data flows without needing to own the underlying technical architecture.

Run programs that create pipeline

 - Secure the people, budget and commitments needed on both sides, then keep programs moving from plan to execution across complex partner organisations

 - Work with Sales on partner lead management and follow-up, and with Field Marketing, Demand Gen, Product Marketing and DevRel on joint go-to-market programs

Extend reach to Tier 2 and emerging-market partners

 - Build co-marketing programs with Tier 2 and regional partners, including in markets such as APAC where partners are our main route in

 - Adapt what works with strategic partners into lighter-weight programs that need less of our time

Build foundations that scale

 - Turn your best programs into repeatable playbooks for every new strategic partner

 - Set up the measurement that links partner activity to engagement, qualified opportunities and partner-sourced pipeline, and run regular performance reviews with partners and internal stakeholders

You'll own the foundations that everything else, including our AI and agent capabilities, is built on.

 

To do so, here are your responsibilities:

 

OWN THE CORE PLATFORM STRATEGY & ROADMAP

 - Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for the Core Platform in partnership with Engineering and Product leadership.

 - Prioritize foundational investments based on customer impact, enterprise needs, technical risk, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs between near-term customer needs, technical debt, and long-term architecture explicit.

 - Lead product discovery for technically complex problems, engaging directly with enterprise customers and internal customer-facing teams.

 

SCALABILITY, RELIABILITY & EXECUTION ENGINE

 - Drive work on the scalability and reliability of n8n's execution engine, including areas like worker pools and distributed execution.

 - Improve the reliability of triggers and execution behaviour across complex deployment setups, from multi-main Cloud environments to self-hosted enterprise installations.

 - Shape a more secure and flexible approach to executing code within n8n.

 

MAJOR RELEASES & CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

 - Drive the planning and release of major or breaking platform versions, including migration strategy, stakeholder communication, and risk management.

 - Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

 - Act as the bridge between the Core team and the wider org: Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Support, making platform trade-offs legible without oversimplifying them.

 - Treat internal product teams as customers of the platform: proactively mine their roadmaps for implicit platform requirements and turn cross-cutting needs into explicit Core Platform work before they become blockers.

 


REQUIREMENTS

 

Must-haves

 - Platform product experience: You have 5+ years in Product, with at least 2 to 3 years on platform, infrastructure, developer-facing, or backend/API products.

 - Technical depth: You're credible with senior engineers. You can reason about distributed systems, execution models, and reliability/scalability trade-offs, and hold your own in an architecture discussion. You're at home with non-functional requirements, where the details are the product.

 - Complex delivery track record: You've led cross-team technical initiatives with real delivery risk, ideally including a migration or breaking change.

 - Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or technical-debt work to customer and commercial outcomes.

 - Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

 - Exceptional communication: You make complex platform topics understandable for technical and non-technical audiences alike.

 - Enterprise platform reality: You understand what running software in customer-controlled environments means, including self-hosted, air-gapped, and restricted deployments

 - Enterprise exposure: You've worked with B2B SaaS requirements like security, compliance, or deployment complexity.

 - Security partnership: You're comfortable working with security teams on code execution, isolation, or compliance topics.

 - Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

 - Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

n8n sits at one of the most interesting UX problems in software right now: more than 80% of workflows built on n8n today involve AI agents, and the platform is in the middle of a deliberate expansion from deeply technical developers toward a broader set of builders. That tension, keeping power users happy while dramatically lowering the floor, is the central design challenge.

This is a foundational hire with a real mandate and direct exec partnership.




WHAT YOU'LL DO


OWN THE QUALITY BAR

 - Set a clear, consistent quality bar that the team can orient around and build toward, so great work becomes the natural output of how we design together.

 - Build review processes and critique rituals that give the team a shared language for quality and the confidence to make strong craft decisions together.

 - Evolve the design system and QA practices so the bar rises as the team grows.

 - Dig into one of the most genuinely interesting UX challenges in the space: n8n has historically had a steep learning curve for new users. Your job is to lower that floor without losing the power that experienced builders love.


DRIVE DESIGN'S STRATEGIC INFLUENCE

 - Shape product strategy, not just respond to it. Bring design thinking into roadmap conversations and help surface user problems before they become someone else's brief.

 - Help lead n8n's expansion toward a broader, less technical audience, a deliberate and exciting strategic shift that design should be leading.

 - Build the kind of relationships with Product, Engineering, and leadership where design is a genuine thought partner at every stage.


BUILD AND GROW THE TEAM

 - Lead a team of around 14 designers today: 2 Design Leads each working with ~6 ICs, plus Design Engineering and UX Research (with more hires ahead).

 - Shape the team structure, career framework, and progression paths so people know where they stand and where they're going.

 - Create a culture of high standards and honest feedback, where people feel supported to do their best work and have a clear sense of what great looks like.

 - Own hiring and headcount planning for the department, and help us grow without losing what makes the team good.


BUILD RESEARCH INTO HOW WE MAKE DECISIONS

 - Establish a pragmatic, continuous research practice from the ground up. We're making our first dedicated UX research hires, so there's real room to shape this.

 - Make customer insight, product data, and community feedback a live input to product decisions, so teams are building from evidence at every step.

 - Connect research to the decisions that matter most: activation, adoption, retention, and helping new users find their way into n8n with confidence.


HELP THE TEAM WORK IN NEW WAYS

 - Champion practical AI adoption inside the design org, from prototyping and research synthesis to design QA and workflow efficiency.

 - Help the team stay curious and current as the tools, patterns, and expectations around AI products continue to evolve fast.

 - Model the kind of working style you want to see: thoughtful, adaptive, and genuinely excited about what's changing.




REQUIREMENTS


MUST-HAVES

 - 🧭 Product design leadership: You have managed managers, coached senior designers, and built design teams that improve both craft and business outcomes, including making hard performance calls when needed.

 - 🧩 Complex product systems experience: You have led design across complex or developer-facing products where UX quality depends on deep product understanding.

 - 🎨 Craft authority: You are a quality bar, not just someone who appreciates quality. You can identify great work, explain why it's great, and hold the line on standards even when it's uncomfortable.

 - 📣 Strategic influence, not just strategic thinking: You have made design a co-equal in product conversations, not a downstream function. You know how to bring people with you, create debate, and drive decisions.

 - 🔀 Structured problem-solving under ambiguity: You find your way into unclear problems and create a plan. You don't just ask good questions, you answer them. You move forward when there's no map.

 - 🤖 AI-era product judgment: You understand the AI, automation, or adjacent tooling landscape and can turn emerging patterns into usable, trustworthy product experiences.

 - 🔍 Research literacy: You know how to build research into product development so insight becomes part of how teams make decisions, not a separate artifact.

 - 📊 Data-informed decision making: You use product analytics, research, and customer evidence to guide decisions instead of relying on taste or opinion alone.

 - 🧱 Org design and performance management: You can design team structures, define career paths, raise expectations, and handle difficult performance conversations with clarity.




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - 🌱 Open-source or community product experience: You have worked on open-source, fair-code, community-led, or builder-driven products and understand what it means to design for a community that has strong opinions.

 - 💻 Design engineering credibility: You have enough front-end or design engineering fluency to partner deeply on design system adoption and implementation quality.

 - 🌍 Remote-first operating systems: You have built design rituals, critique, QA, and collaboration practices that work across distributed teams and time zones.

 - 🚀 Growth surface experience: You have worked on activation, onboarding, templates, time-to-value, or product-led growth surfaces.

 - ⬆️ Rising Design Manager profile: We are open to someone who has been an exceptional Design Manager and is ready for their first Head-level role, if the fundamentals are exceptional.

BUILD & LEAD A HIGH-PERFORMING FDE TEAM

OWN REGIONAL DELIVERY & CUSTOMER OUTCOMES

 - Lead regional engagement intake and prioritization with Customer Success, Sales, and Partnerships, focusing resources on high-value accounts, strategic adoption opportunities, and at-risk renewals.

 - Qualify and scope customer engagements, selecting the right mix of internal FDEs and delivery partners while ensuring clear success criteria, technical ownership, and timelines.

ENABLE CUSTOMERS & SCALE TECHNICAL EXCELLENCE

DRIVE PARTNER QUALITY & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

You'll be embedded in a product squad alongside a product manager, engineering manager and around three to five engineers, owning the user experience for your area end to end. Our design team is small but growing, so you'll shape the craft bar and the culture, not inherit them.

 - Enterprise (two roles: Governance & Observability, and Licence & Billing): You've worked on technical B2B platforms. Governance & Observability gives admins visibility and the controls to enforce how n8n is used, from audit logging and execution diagnostics to admin settings. Licence & Billing covers licensing, subscriptions, usage-based billing and the cloud admin experience.

 - Knowledge: You have exceptional product sense and can connect disparate elements into a coherent whole. You'll take something complex, with many moving parts, and make it make sense. The team works on how agents and automations access company knowledge, and on core workflow-building surfaces such as data tables, sub-workflow execution and the canvas. Experience with data visualisation is welcome; deep technical expertise isn't required.

 - n8n Labs: As a Product Designer, you'll own discovery end to end: spotting the riskiest assumptions, running the research and turning findings into decisions without waiting on a brief. You move fast, cut scope without losing what matters, and you're hands-on enough to build and ship your own prototypes, including using AI tools to get there quicker. You've got product and business judgement, not just craft; you can spot an opportunity and make the case for it. Founder or co-founder experience is a helpful signal but not a requirement.

Team assignment is confirmed at the offer stage and may be subject to change as the team structure evolves.



🎯 Regardless of the team, your main goal will be to lead end-to-end product design on complex workflows that elevate n8n's user experience, ship measurable outcomes, and raise the quality bar across our platform. To do so, here are your responsibilities:

End-to-end product design

 - Lead the full design process for your team, from discovery to polished delivery, collaborating closely with PMs and engineers.

 - Consistently ship high-quality, visually cohesive designs that improve the overall UX at every release.

 - Work effectively on complex features and understand the underlying technology.

 - Take ownership of complex, multi-faceted problems and drive them to completion with initiative and autonomy.

Research, feedback, and UX quality

 - Own the direction of research for your team: decide when it's needed, choose the right methodology, and take the initiative without waiting to be told.

 - Champion the user by talking to them regularly and running research that informs critical product and business decisions.

 - Master the feedback loop by gathering, synthesising and acting on input while giving actionable critique to elevate teammates' work.

 - Balance speed and quality in an MVP-driven environment, navigating ambiguity while maintaining a high bar.

Systems thinking and platform coherence

 - Design in systems, integrating solutions into the broader n8n platform and safeguarding the product's big picture.

 - Account for edge cases, constraints and interaction details so users never end up in impossible states.

 - Collaborate across teams and designers to ensure consistency and quality across shared patterns and components.

Strategy, impact, and innovation

 - Shape team strategy by influencing planning, prioritisation and scope with a strong design perspective tied to KPIs.

 - Explore and adopt AI and automation tools to push the boundaries of design practice and AI-powered workflows.

Senior or Staff?

We're open at multiple levels and we'll calibrate with you during the process, based on the scope you've operated at. At Senior, you own your squad's design end to end and ship work that raises the bar for your area. At Staff, you do that, and your influence reaches beyond your own squad: you shape patterns other designers build on, and you take on the problems that span teams. All levels are hands-on: this is not a step away from the craft.



REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

 - 🎨 Product design excellence: You're proficient across product design, UX and UI, comfortable with qualitative research, and you deliver polished, detail-oriented work.

 - 🏗️ Complex product experience: You've designed complex, information-dense products, ideally technical B2B web products. Consumer-only or mobile-only portfolios are unlikely to be the right fit.

 - 🧠 Technical mindset: You collaborate effectively with engineers and understand how software is built, including common web technologies. You don't need to write code, but you do need genuine curiosity about what's happening underneath: APIs, webhooks, data structures and how workflows actually execute.

 - 🧭 Ownership & delivery: You've shipped end-to-end features in smaller teams or startups and can drive complex problems to measurable outcomes.

 - ⚡ Fast, focused execution: You operate at high speed in an MVP-driven environment, balancing quality and velocity amid ambiguity.

 - 📈 Outcome orientation: You use research and metrics to inform decisions and consistently deliver solutions that enable team KPIs.

 - 🤝 Feedback & collaboration: You're open and non-defensive in critique and provide actionable feedback that raises the team's bar.

 - 🧪 Curiosity for AI: You're enthusiastic about AI and innovation, actively exploring new tools and approaches to advance the craft.

 - 📅 Experience level: You have 5+ years in product design with demonstrable impact on shipped products.



Nice-to-haves

 - 💻 Front-end fluency: You build with code or AI coding tools (HTML/CSS/JavaScript, vibe-coding) and collaborate effectively with engineers on the result. It isn't required, but it helps.

 - 🧩 AI & automation domain: You've designed AI or automation products; familiarity with n8n is a plus.

 - 🔁 Process improvement: You proactively refine team rituals and workflows to increase effectiveness.

 - 📚 Continuous growth: You invest in your craft and are motivated by creating tangible product and company impact.

 - 🔎 Discovery frameworks: You know methodologies like Continuous Discovery or Shape Up.

 - 📊 Data-informed design: You're comfortable with metrics, A/B testing or SQL to guide decisions.

 - 🚀 Entrepreneurial drive: You've built startups or side projects that show initiative and creative problem-solving.



How we hire

Our process has five stages: a conversation with our talent acquisition partner; a skills interview with a design manager, built around a short, low-fidelity design exercise; a whiteboard challenge with a design manager and a product designer; a portfolio presentation with a design manager and a product manager; and a final conversation with our VP of Product and Design.



Why join us?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into a slide deck. You'll lead high-impact design across core product surfaces, shaping AI-powered workflows, enterprise governance and billing, and how agents and automations work with company knowledge, from discovery to delivery. You'll join a fast-growing, Europe-based, remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation and craft matter, partnering closely with PMs and engineers to ship real outcomes to a passionate global community.

  • Commercial Accountability & Expansion: Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence.   • AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.

  • Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.

    • Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.

Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.

About the role

As a CE Specialist you will be the trusted technical advisor for customers adopting Cloudflare's network services. These include Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare Network Firewall and Cloudflare Network Interconnect (CNI), alongside Cloudflare One. You will lead Magic Transit and Cloudflare WAN POCs from design through to production cutover. You will also help customers modernize how they protect, connect and secure their networks and sites.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a trusted advisor, helping customers choose the right Cloudflare network and security solution for their business needs.
  • Lead qualified prospects through Solution Design and POC.
    • Magic Transit: plan and run POCs covering BGP onboarding, prefix advertisement, GRE/IPsec tunnels or CNI, and DDoS validation.
    • Cloudflare WAN: plan and run POCs covering site and branch connectivity (IPsec/GRE tunnels, CNI, Cloudflare One Appliance), data center and cloud-to-site connectivity, routing design, and coexistence with or migration from existing SD-WAN or MPLS.
  • Understand the customer's network topology, IP addressing, routing policy and security requirements. Then design an architecture that fits, including hybrid environments with Azure, AWS and GCP.
  • Run technical discovery, demos and workshops as part of the pre-sales cycle. Support RFP/RFI responses and technical validation.
  • Explain the benefits of Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN and Cloudflare One compared with alternative approaches. These include traditional DDoS scrubbing services, appliance-based protection, SD-WAN solutions, next-generation firewalls and MPLS or traditional WAN.
  • Work with GTM partners to consistently achieve pipeline and revenue goals.
  • Present network and security transformation messages to senior technical leaders and executives.
  • Capture product and feature gaps and feed them back to Product and Engineering.

Core requirements

  • GTM experience: 5+ years in Customer Engineering, Pre-sales, Solutions or Systems Engineering, or Technical Sales. You should have experience guiding customers through discovery, solution design, POC and handover to delivery or support.
  • BGP and routing: Strong working knowledge of BGP (eBGP, route advertisement and filtering, AS paths, communities, anycast, RPKI and route hygiene). You should also be comfortable with static and dynamic routing, subnetting, route-based policy and split tunnels.
  • TCP/IP: Deep understanding of the TCP/IP protocol stack and packet-level troubleshooting (for example with tcpdump and Wireshark). This includes MTU/MSS, tunneling (GRE, IPsec), NAT and asymmetric routing.
  • DDoS protection: Understanding of L3/L4/L7 DDoS attack types and mitigation approaches (for example volumetric floods, SYN floods, amplification and reflection attacks). You should also understand how on-demand and always-on protection differ.
  • SD-WAN and WAN architecture: Familiarity with SD-WAN architectures and routing protocols (BGP and OSPF overlays), underlay and overlay design, local internet breakout, branch connectivity, and migration from MPLS or legacy WAN.
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken. Additional languages are a plus.
  • Ability to manage a project, work to deadlines and prioritize between competing goals.
  • Curiosity and learning agility. Cloudflare sits at the cutting edge of internet technology, so you are expected to keep up with industry trends as well as our own products.

Desirable skills

Network and security fundamentals

  • DNS: Good knowledge of DNS, including authoritative and recursive resolution, DNSSEC, DNS over HTTPS/TLS, DNS-based attacks (such as tunneling and cache poisoning) and DNS filtering.
  • Detailed understanding of the path from user to application, including hybrid and multi-cloud architectures (Azure, AWS, GCP).

  • Experience designing or scaling distributed systems where latency, throughput, availability, and correctness all matter.
  • Ability to work comfortably across the stack, from API design and product surfaces to backend services, queues, storage systems, control planes, or performance-critical code.
  • Strong developer tools taste. You have used and built enough APIs, SDKs, dashboards, CLIs, docs, and internal platforms to know what makes them delightful or painful.
