About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Location: Austin, San Francisco or New York

About the role

Cloudflare is hiring a Data Center Architect to define and deliver the physical infrastructure behind high-density compute and GPU deployments across our global network. You'll own 3 connected domains: the liquid cooling chain, the low-voltage connectivity layer, and the MV/LV electrical architecture that powers both.

This is a senior individual-contributor role spanning architecture, detailed design, technical qualification, design governance, commissioning, and operational readiness. You're Cloudflare's owner-side technical lead in these domains: the person who connects what our hardware needs with what colocation providers, equipment manufacturers, and delivery partners can actually build.

Scope runs from a single rack in commercial colocation to multi-megawatt compute deployments. You'll design power, cooling, and cabling as one system so they don't fight each other at the rack, in the white space, or during maintenance.

If your background is only HVAC design, only cold-plate research, or only utility-scale generation, this role will be wider than you expect. We need someone who can hold the electrical, cooling, and cabling layers together.

About the team

We work with engineering, capacity planning, network strategy, supply chain, and operations to grow Cloudflare's data center and PoP footprint. With colocation providers, hardware suppliers, and delivery partners worldwide, we turn infrastructure requirements into deployments that come online faster, cost less, and work the first time.

What you'll do

Architecture and reference designs

  • Own the physical-infrastructure architecture. Build reference designs for power, liquid cooling, and connectivity for AI and high-density compute, including how they interface at rack, row, and site level. Maintain the standards, templates, and libraries that deployment, operations, and partner teams build from.
  • Translate hardware and capacity needs into engineering requirements. Turn heat loads, electrical loads, port counts, network topologies, and growth plans into power, cooling, and connectivity requirements and into site and rack qualification criteria.
  • Qualify sites and facility interfaces. Assess provider power and cooling availability, utility and backup capacity, water supply and return conditions, hydraulic capacity, upstream heat rejection, expansion headroom, maintenance constraints, and contractual boundaries. Give go/no-go recommendations with the risks written down.

Electrical power architecture (MV/LV)

  • Lead MV and LV electrical architecture: single-line diagrams, power distribution, switchgear and UPS topology, busway and PDU design, grounding and bonding.
  • Design physical power infrastructure, AC and DC, including power conversion, backup generation, energy storage, and distribution, with attention to fault levels, selectivity, and maintainability.
  • Validate designs with modeling: load-flow, short-circuit, arc-flash, and selectivity studies, checked against measured performance where possible.
  • Define digital power requirements for monitoring, metering, protection coordination, and control. Work with controls and operations teams on alarm thresholds, trend retention, remote monitoring, and BMS/SCADA integration.
  • Fold emerging standards (NEC, NFPA, UL, OCP power and rack specs) into forward-looking electrical designs.

Liquid cooling

  • Own the liquid-cooling architecture and roadmap. Develop repeatable direct-to-chip designs and evaluate liquid-to-liquid, liquid-to-air, rear-door, and other approaches against deployment needs.
  • Design and validate the hydraulic system. Flow and pressure-drop calculations, pipe sizing, pump selection, balancing, and control requirements. Validate at partial load, during expansion and maintenance, and in failure scenarios, not just at nameplate.
  • Specify equipment and rack integration. Qualify CDUs, heat exchangers, pumps, manifolds, hoses, quick-disconnects, valves, and instrumentation. Coordinate rack access, piping routes, service clearances, and installation sequencing with the electrical, cabling, hardware, and structural disciplines.
  • Own coolant integrity and serviceability. Set manufacturer-aligned requirements for fluid quality, material compatibility, cleanliness, filtration, corrosion control, condensation prevention, and leak detection. Make isolation, fluid handling, component replacement, and servicing safe and maintainable.

Low-voltage connectivity and structured cabling

  • Own the physical-layer architecture. Reference designs for rack, row, cage, and site connectivity: copper and fiber distribution, patch-panel placement, cross-connect demarcations, diverse routes, and reserved expansion capacity.
  • Engineer fiber and copper connectivity. Specify media, connectors, trunks, cassettes, and patching for equipment reach and performance. Validate optical loss budgets, connector counts, polarity, breakouts, bend radius, and compatibility across hardware generations.
  • Produce buildable designs. Pathway layouts, fiber schedules, port-to-port patching plans, cable-length schedules, bills of materials, and installation specs.
  • Connect to colocation and carrier infrastructure. Qualify meet-me-room access, provider pathways, cross-connect options, demarcation points, and route diversity. Define handoffs with data center providers, carriers, ISPs, and Cloudflare's network strategy team.

Integration, controls, and resilience

  • Coordinate white-space interfaces. Layouts that account for rack access, airflow, liquid-cooling pipes and manifolds, power segregation, pathway capacity, and expansion. Coordinate supports, bonding, grounding, and firestopping with the responsible disciplines and providers.
  • Design for resilience and controlled failure. Evaluate redundancy, shared failure dependencies, cooling and power interruptions, and thermal ride-through. Agree protective responses with hardware and operations teams for pump or CDU failure, loss of facility cooling, leaks, sensor faults, control failures, and power events.
  • Define controls and operational visibility: temperatures, pressures, flows, power metering, leak alarms, equipment status, and capacity telemetry.

Governance, delivery, and acceptance

  • Be Cloudflare's owner-side design authority. Own basis-of-design documents, single-line diagrams, P&IDs, cabling and equipment schedules, interface requirements, scopes, responsibility matrices, review gates, and acceptance criteria. Review partner designs and contractor submittals, resolve RFIs and technical disputes, and drive deviations to documented closure.
  • Lead delivery and live-site changes. Guide contractors and remote hands through new deployments, expansions, migrations, and remediation. Work with deployment and operations on installation sequencing, methods of procedure, change controls, and rollback plans that protect running services.
  • Lead commissioning and acceptance. Define factory and site acceptance tests across electrical, cooling, and connectivity: cleanliness and leak-test evidence, flow balancing, loaded performance tests, failure-mode testing, and copper and fiber certification (fiber inspection and cleaning, insertion-loss testing, OTDR where appropriate). Track deficiencies and verify corrective work before sign-off.
  • Keep the physical source of truth accurate. Define labeling and connectivity-record standards. Make sure as-builts, power and cooling records, patching schedules, cross-connect inventories, and test records reconcile with Cloudflare's infrastructure inventory and DCIM.
  • Oversee handover: deficiency closure, operator training, maintenance procedures, spares, and turnover documentation before production.

Cost, efficiency, and standards

  • Support sourcing. RFPs, technical bid evaluation, technical negotiations, supplier qualification, and lifecycle cost analysis. Partner with supply chain on prefabricated assemblies, preterminated cabling, rack integration, lead times, and alternatives that cut field labor without cutting quality.
  • Reduce energy and water use. Evaluate phased deployment, consumption, and retrofit options.
  • Evolve standards from evidence. Investigate incidents and recurring installation defects with network and operations teams. Feed commissioning and operating results back into designs, standards, and quality checks.

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years in data center mechanical, electrical, or physical-layer infrastructure, critical-facility cooling, or structured cabling, including architecture or technical design leadership.
  • Bachelor's in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Delivered liquid-cooled compute infrastructure from requirements through commissioning or production handover. Conventional HVAC experience alone doesn't qualify.
  • Create and review electrical single-line diagrams and schematics, with hands-on MV/LV system design including protection, selectivity, and grounding.
  • Strong command of thermodynamics, heat transfer, fluid mechanics, hydraulic calculations, pump and heat-exchanger selection, and cooling performance under variable conditions.
  • Practical experience with CDUs, facility and technology cooling loops, rack distribution, coolant compatibility, leak detection, and the interfaces between liquid-cooled hardware and facility systems.
  • Strong knowledge of copper Ethernet, single-mode and multimode fiber, patching systems, LC and MPO/MTP connectivity, optical loss budgets, polarity, cable management, and the applicable test methods.
  • Experience in colocation environments: cross-connect delivery, diverse physical paths, and the practical constraints of building inside third-party facilities.
  • Able to write and critically review basis-of-design documents, P&IDs, electrical and mechanical specifications, equipment selections, operating sequences, and test plans.
  • Working knowledge of NEC, NFPA, UL, mechanical and plumbing codes, TIA and ISO/IEC structured-cabling standards, relevant ASHRAE data center guidance, and manufacturer operating requirements, and the ability to apply them with qualified local engineering partners.
  • Experience evaluating resilience and maintainability, participating in commissioning, and resolving system-level problems across equipment and organizational boundaries.
  • Experience directing design consultants, contractors, installation partners, or remote hands, with clear ownership of technical decisions and acceptance outcomes.
  • Clear written and verbal communication across disciplines and time zones, and able to run several projects with limited oversight.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continuing and permanent basis without company sponsorship. [Confirm wording with recruiting.]

Bonus points

  • PE, Chartered Engineer, or equivalent registration in electrical or mechanical engineering.
  • BICSI RCDD, DCDC, or a comparable credential.
  • High-density GPU platforms, OCP rack, power, and cooling interfaces, or qualification across multiple hardware and cooling suppliers.
  • Hydraulic and electrical modeling tools (AFT Fathom, PIPE-FLO, ETAP, SKM), thermal or CFD modeling, and validating models against measured performance.
  • High-density optical distribution, parallel optics, preterminated assemblies, and cabling transitions across successive network generations.
  • Modular or prefabricated power or cooling infrastructure, live-site retrofits, DCIM platforms, automated connectivity or telemetry analysis, or lifecycle energy and water performance.
  • Familiarity with Cloudflare-relevant network environments: optical transport, ISP interconnection, out-of-band management, and liquid-cooled rack integration.

Travel

Travel for site assessments, vendor reviews, factory testing, commissioning, and deployment support, including international travel.

What success looks like

Sites are qualified against real hardware requirements. Power, cooling, and connectivity responsibilities are unambiguous. Systems prove their electrical, thermal, and connectivity performance, including failure behavior, before handover. Operations has the monitoring, procedures, training, and spares to run them.

Why Cloudflare

Your work shapes how Cloudflare deploys physical infrastructure across a global network, from long-term architectural choices to getting the next cage online.

Strong candidates take different paths. If your experience shows the core capabilities but doesn't match every line above, apply anyway.

Cloudflare sits in front of around 20% of the web and sees both sides of that exchange. Our team, the Agentic Internet team, is focused on making the web readable, discoverable, callable, and payable, built on open standards so no single company owns the rails. Signals & Data Products turns our network's view into products both sides can use: helping AI labs know what's fresh and trustworthy, and helping site owners see and shape how they show up in AI.   • Define what makes a signal worth paying for (freshness, provenance, trust, real-world usage) using data from Cloudflare's network
  • Build for both sides of the market: data products for AI labs, and visibility for site owners into how AI models find, use, and cite them
  • Explore what comes next, from knowledge graphs to measuring how sites show up in AI answers

Available Locations

  • San Francisco, US
  • We are only considering locally based candidates OR candidates looking to move to the Bay Area.

  • Customer Engineer - (AI & Start-Ups) 


    • About the Role
      Digital Native SEs at Cloudflare work with the most innovative and cutting-edge companies on the planet — the startups and high-growth, cloud-native businesses that are building the next generation of Internet products. These are companies where the developers are the decision makers, and where the CTO is often personally responsible for shipping new products and getting the company's AI initiatives off the ground.
      This role is for a technologist who genuinely enjoys being in the room with builders. You'll be equally comfortable jumping into a Slack channel with a founding engineer, whiteboarding an architecture with a lead developer, and stepping into a strategic conversation with a CTO about their platform and AI roadmap. You speak the language of engineers fluently and can hold a credible, detailed technical conversation — but this is not a software developer role, and you won't be writing production code every day. Your superpower is technical discovery, translation, and evangelism: understanding what a builder is trying to accomplish, mapping it to the full breadth of the Cloudflare Developer Platform, and inspiring teams to build on Cloudflare rather than just consume a single service.
      The Digital Native segment leans heavily on Solutions Engineering to lead technical discovery within the cloud-developer vertical. You'll be expected to go deep on the Cloudflare Developer Platform — Workers, Durable Objects, Workers AI, R2, KV, D1, Vectorize, Queues, Pages, and the broader developer ecosystem — far beyond basic storage, and to make the case for Cloudflare as the place to build. This role covers both the acquisition of new Digital Native accounts and the expansion of existing ones. The ideal candidate is a "builder" personality with a strong mix of pre-sales/technical customer-facing experience who thrives in an agile, fast-moving environment.
      What you'll do as a Senior Solutions Engineer
      The Pre-Sales Solution Engineering organization owns the technical sales of the Cloudflare solution portfolio, ensuring maximal business value, fit-for-purpose solution design and adoption roadmap for our customers. Solution Engineering is made up of individuals from a wide range of backgrounds including but not limited to Sales Consultants, Technical Consultants, Technical Support and Program Managers.
      You are a customer-facing technologist within the Cloudflare Solutions Engineering team, focused on the developer-first, digital-native segment. You have experience in a pre-sales or other technical customer-facing role, and you're at your best when engaging directly with engineering teams and technical founders. In this role you'll partner closely with the sales team from the very start of the cycle — joining early discovery calls, qualifying opportunities from the get-go, and embedding yourself in customer Slack channels and working sessions. You'll lead technical discovery, deliver compelling demos and architecture discussions, run proof-of-concept builds, and evangelize the Cloudflare Developer Platform as the foundation for our customers' next products and AI initiatives.
      Responsibilities
      Specifically, we are looking for you to:
      • Lead technical discovery within the cloud-developer vertical — asking the right questions to uncover how a customer builds, what they're trying to ship, and where Cloudflare fits.
      • Engage early and often: join sales-led discovery calls from the outset, help qualify deals from the get-go, and stay embedded with customer teams (including in their Slack channels and working sessions) throughout the cycle.
      • Identify and map customer initiatives and business problems — especially around new product development and AI initiatives — to the Cloudflare platform.
      • Build relationships and technical champions within customer accounts, from founding engineers and developers up to the CTO.
      • Develop and present tailored technical content and demos for both hands-on developer audiences and senior technical leadership.
      • Lead demo and proof-of-concept / build activities for Cloudflare prospects and customers.
      • Evangelize the Cloudflare Developer Platform (Workers, Workers AI, Durable Objects, R2, D1, KV, Vectorize, Queues, Pages and more) — making the case for customers to build on Cloudflare, not just use it for storage or CDN.
      • Demonstrate your expertise with your peers through the creation of professional content, including reference architectures, demos, blog posts and other knowledge-sharing activities.
      • Represent and evangelize Cloudflare externally at Developer, Community, Technology and Industry events with thought leadership and expertise.
      • Apply in-depth vertical knowledge or domain expertise. Advise on best practices.
      Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience
      • Previous experience as a Solutions Engineer or other customer-facing technical role, ideally selling to or working with developer-led, cloud-native, or startup organizations.
      • A genuine "builder" mindset and the personality to match: you enjoy talking to developers, you're curious, and you naturally gravitate toward technical problem-solving conversations.
      • The ability to speak engineers' language credibly — you can hold your own on architecture, APIs, and platform design — without this being a hands-on, code-every-day developer role.
      • Strong technical discovery instincts: you know how to draw out requirements, qualify fit early, and separate real needs from noise.
      • A good mix of pre-sales / technical sales experience and comfort operating in an agile, fast-moving environment (joining Slack channels, iterating quickly, engaging in early-stage calls, and qualifying deals from the start).
      • Solid communication, written and presentation skills, with the range to talk to both a hands-on developer and a CTO in the same day.
      • Ability to work on several projects and activities concurrently.
      • Highly driven, curious, team-oriented, and able to work with a sense of urgency.
      • You've built web applications before, or contributed to existing web applications in a meaningful way — enough to have real empathy for how developers work.
      • Polished communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to drive a discussion with a broad range of stakeholders (from the web developer to the CTO/CISO).
      • Relationship building: a proven track record of building deep technical relationships with engineers and technical founders. Experience managing various stakeholder relationships to build consensus on technical solutions/projects.
      • Experience managing technical sales within accounts, including developing champion-style relationships, driving technical wins, and assisting with technical validation.
      • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in relevant work experience.
      • The role requires up to 50% travel to attend meetings with prospects or customers, attend conferences and other industry events, and to collaborate with your Cloudflare teammates.
      A deep understanding of the Cloudflare Developer Platform and core industry components (and a desire to learn more):
      • The Cloudflare Developer Platform — serverless compute and application development with Workers, Durable Objects, Workers AI, R2, KV, D1, Vectorize, Queues, and Pages. Familiarity with building or architecting applications on a serverless/edge platform is a strong plus.
      • AI/GenAI application patterns — inference at the edge, RAG, vector databases, and how startups are operationalizing AI initiatives.
      • HTTP technologies including reverse proxy (e.g., WAF and CDN), forward proxy (secure web gateway), and serverless application development.
      • Internet security technologies including DDoS and DDoS mitigation, Firewalls, TLS, VPN, DLP.
      • Networking technologies including TCP, UDP, DNS, IPv4 + IPv6, BGP routing, GRE, SD-WAN, MPLS, Global Traffic Management.
      • Zero-trust network access (ZTNA & SASE) concepts including identity management and authentication.
      • Cloud computing technologies such as AWS, GCP, Azure and others.

Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.

Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.

This role features a competitive base salary and a variable compensation structure tied directly to the successful execution of full-lifecycle commercial targets, including new business acquisition, ongoing adoption milestones, and overall account expansion. Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:

  • San Francisco, CA
  • Austin, TX
  • London, UK

Role summary

We’re looking for a visionary, hands-on storyteller to reinvent how Cloudflare brings customer impact to life. This person will combine the narrative instincts of an exceptional writer and editor, the technical fluency of a product marketer, the relationship skills of a customer advocate, and the creative eye of a producer. You'll interview customers and their executives, find out what was at stake for them, and explain what they built on Cloudflare in language a CFO and a developer can both follow.

We welcome ideas no one has tried yet. You'll own the creative standard for video and content. You will raise the creative and production bar across video, case studies, campaigns, executive content, and onstage moments, helping make Cloudflare more relatable without sacrificing technical credibility. You will also build repeatable, AI-enabled workflows that enable us to discover, produce, and amplify distinctive customer stories at scale.

Role responsibilities

  • Interview customers and find the story: Work directly with customers and their executives to learn what problem they had and what changed after they solved it. 
  • Explain the technology in simple terms: Turn topics like Zero Trust or Workers AI into stories that business and technical readers can both follow, and keep the technical details right.
  • Lead a few big moments each year: Own a few major storytelling projects a year, such as a film, a campaign, or a customer segment in a Cloudflare Connect keynote.
  • Come up with ideas that get noticed: Pitch creative concepts that make people stop scrolling, such as a surprising angle or a format no one else has tried.
  • Try new formats: Pilot formats beyond the case study, such as documentary-style series, live builds, short social video, interactive data stories, customer takeovers, and podcasts.
  • Set the quality standard: Decide what good looks like for customer stories in every format, and hold agencies, freelancers, and internal teams to it.
  • Supply executives with stories: Give Cloudflare leaders the customer stories and proof points they use in keynotes, briefings, social posts, and customer meetings.
  • Work across teams to get stories approved: Source stories with Sales and Product, and work with Marketing, Communications, and Legal to get approvals.
  • Use AI to scale: Build repeatable AI workflows for spotting story candidates, preparing interviews, drafting, and cutting one story into versions for each channel.
  • Track results: Decide how we measure story impact (sales usage, pipeline influence, reach, advocate engagement) and use the numbers to choose what to make next.

Desirable skills, knowledge, and experience 

  • Technical fluency: You can read a product doc or architecture diagram and explain in plain language what a customer built and why it matters.
  • Reporter and editor instincts: You ask the follow-up question and find the detail other people missed. You can read a draft and say what's missing, and you write copy that works for a CISO and for a developer.
  • Creative judgment and taste: You can tell quickly whether a story will get attention or build credibility. You know good film, editorial, design, and social work when you see it, and you borrow ideas from outside tech, including media, sports, and entertainment.
  • Production experience: You've had some experience directing or producing customer video, documentary, podcast, or live content, and you can manage crews and agencies.
  • Executive presence and influence: You're comfortable interviewing a customer's C-suite and briefing a Cloudflare executive before a keynote. You can get Sales, Product, Marketing, Comms, IT, and Legal moving in the same direction, and you push back when a story isn't ready.
  • AI in your daily work: You already use AI tools for writing, research, interview prep, or production, and you can show us how.

Qualifications

  • 10-15 years of experience in one or more of the following: Developer Relations, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Journalism, or Video Production. B2B technology experience is strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Option to include customer stories, video, campaigns, or stage content you created or led, with a short note on what made each one work. Original creative concepts or formats that performed well, with results you can point to (for example reach, press coverage, or sales impact).
  • Experience producing stories with enterprise customers and their executives, including getting them through customer, Legal, and Comms approval.
  • Experience explaining complex technical products (infrastructure, security, developer platforms, or AI) to business and technical audiences.
  • Experience producing video and live or stage content from start to finish.
  • Experience building a content program or production workflow that other people could run is preferred

Compensation

  • Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location

    • For San Francisco Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $221,000 - $304,000.

Equity

Benefits

  • Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!   • Time Off

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Toronto, Ontario

About the Department

The Cloudflare sales team is comprised of Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together to acquire customers and help them adopt Cloudflare technologies to create great Internet-enabled experiences.

The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real security and performance challenges while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free services to millions in our community.

What you'll do

We are looking for an experienced Sales Director to lead and grow the Enterprise and Public Sector  business in Ontario with responsibility for driving Cloudflare's revenue and brand awareness in the region. Based in the Greater Toronto Area and reporting directly to the Canadian VP, the Sales Director will require both strategic and hands-on leadership skills to lead the go-to-market strategy, including hiring, leading and growing the sales team, building pipeline, and driving sales to grow the business in the region. In this role you will work actively with prospects, customers, partners and field sales professionals to sell and close deals to build the region.

Additional responsibilities will include:

  • Design, build and execute strategies for the Region in collaboration with regional and global functional leaders
  • Lead and grow the Central Canada Enterprise and Public Sector (Named) sales team working with global functional leaders and recruiting resources.
  • Serve as the local point person for all Named functions in Canada including customer relationships, pipeline development, account management, sales and partnerships.
  • Drive business cadence for forecast calls, business  reviews, deal reviews, customer account reviews, weekly team meetings and periodic company-wide meetings.
  • Lead programs and campaigns - working across sales, marketing, customer success, solutions engineering, business development and support - to drive awareness, pipeline and sales results.
  • Drive sales growth through successful leadership, organizational planning, customer service and outstanding execution of all regional sales and go-to-market strategies.  
  • Represent Cloudflare as the single point of contact for all Regional operational concerns, ensuring proper and timely escalation and resolution.
  • Ensure that corporate policy and regulatory initiatives are consistently applied and followed by team members.
  • Outstanding leadership that inspires interpersonal effectiveness, develops talent and effects change. Willing and able to be a “doer” and “influencer”.
  • Represent Cloudflare at external conferences and events.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • 10+ years of direct B2B sales experience, selling to large Enterprise accounts 
  • 5+ years of direct sales management experience leading an Enterprise field sales team.
  • Experience managing and coaching long, complex, high value Enterprise sales cycles 
  • Experience selling into top tier accounts in key verticals including Financial Services, Retail, Industrial. Energy and Media.
  • Understanding of IaaS, Networking and Information Security services.
  • Aptitude for learning technical concepts/terms (Technical background in engineering, computer science or MIS a plus).
  • Strong leadership, presentation, interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills.
  • Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

Cloudflare is a system spanning the globe, on a mission to make the Internet better, safer, and more powerful every day. As a Software Engineer at Cloudflare, you’ll work on the code that runs close to the end user, runs at a massive scale, and is deployed to 330+ cities around the world.

https://blog.cloudflare.com/eliminating-hardware-with-load-balancing-and-cloudflare-one/

https://blog.cloudflare.com/extending-local-traffic-management-load-balancing-to-layer-4-with-spectrum/

  • Design, implement, and maintain the software systems that comprise Cloudflare’s Load Balancing product.
  • Participate in all stages of the software development lifecycle, from designing and documenting systems to writing code, automated tests, and monitoring production deployments.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including security, network engineering, SRE, and product management, to design scalable solutions to difficult technical problems.
  • Review work from your peers throughout all stages of the development lifecycle to ensure high-quality, maintainable code.
  • Mentor team members and work with support teams to ensure customer delight and bring out the best in everyone.
  • Debug issues in complex systems and contribute to the maintenance and improvement of operational health.
  • Work with a wide range of technologies and programming languages, including Go, Rust, and Typescript, as well as various databases (SQL and No-SQL), Docker, and Kubernetes.

Role Requirements 

  • First and foremost curiosity and critical thinking
  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience with a technology company
  • Strong programming skills in Go, Rust, C++, or a similar systems-level language
  • Experience building and operating distributed systems
  • Experience with modern Unix/Linux development and runtime environments
  • Experience with monitoring, alerting and debugging high volume production systems
  • Experience with databases (we use PostgreSQL and Clickhouse)
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools like Prometheus and Grafana.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.

About the Role

Cloudflare's developer platform lets developers build full-stack applications that run on a global network. Alongside Workers, developers rely on a growing set of data products: D1 for serverless SQLite, Durable Objects for stateful coordination, KV for global key-value storage, R2 for object storage, and Hyperdrive for connecting to existing databases.

This role will be leading a new database product from its earliest days. You will define what the product is, who it is for, and why developers should choose it over the databases they already know. Then you will get it to first customers and see it through to general availability.

Your mission in this role is to lead the project of building a database designed for agent-driven development workflows, getting both the core tradeoffs and the fine-grained details right.

What You'll Do

  • Run customer discovery to find and sharpen the problem the product should solve.
  • Define the product, its target users, and its positioning against established databases.
  • Work with engineering on core design tradeoffs across consistency, latency, scale, durability, and cost to serve.
  • Recruit design partners and run a private beta that produces honest, usable feedback.
  • Set success metrics and use them to decide what to build, change, or cut.
  • Own pricing and packaging, grounded in customer value and unit economics.
  • Drive the product from first prototype through beta, launch, and GA.
  • Make sure it fits naturally with Workers, Wrangler, and Cloudflare's existing data products.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Developer Relations, Sales, and Customer Support teams.
  • Represent Cloudflare externally at conferences, community events, customer meetings, and developer-focused initiatives.

Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Proven experience as an EM, PM or founder. You've led teams to ship before and can point to impact.
  • Experience taking a product from 0 to 1. You are comfortable with ambiguity and can turn an open problem into a clear plan.
  • Real experience building on databases. You have modeled data, written queries, and run SQL or NoSQL databases in production.
  • Solid grasp of distributed-systems tradeoffs. You can reason through replication, consistency models, and failure modes with engineers.
  • Comfort with pricing and unit economics for infrastructure. You know what a workload costs to serve and how that shapes a price.
  • Deep empathy for developers and how they choose and adopt new platforms. You understand what it's like to bet your application on a database someone else built.
  • Hands-on ability to write code and use AI and the Internet to learn new things fast.
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills. You can translate between engineering domains and align diverse teams on goals.
  • Passion for design details and polish. You raise the bar for sweating the details.
  • External presentation skills. You can walk into a room of developers and build trust and credibility.

Infrastructure Operations builds and manages the data center infrastructure behind Cloudflare's global network. The organization brings together engineering, operations, hardware and logistics teams that plan, deploy, operate and maintain our footprint in hundreds of cities worldwide. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.

About the Role

We're looking for Data Center Engineers to be the hands, eyes and judgment on the ground at our new sites. You'll work on-site every day at your home data center, helping bring it online and keeping its hardware healthy once it's in production.

You'll rack, cable and replace equipment, troubleshoot servers and network gear well past a simple parts swap, and keep every asset accurately documented from the moment it arrives. You'll work alongside colocation staff, integrators and partner teams, and support other sites remotely when the team needs you. Experienced engineers will have room to act as the technical lead for their site, mentor others, and help set the standards the team uses everywhere.

We're building these sites to run with less manual effort than traditional data centers. When something breaks, we expect you to fix it for good, not just for today, and to use AI and automation to make the fix stick, whether that means a better runbook, a script, or a change to how the team works.

This role is hands-on at the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. You'll use the command line to troubleshoot servers and Layer 2 network issues, but network configuration and server provisioning are owned by partner engineering teams.

Site Builds

  • Support integrated site builds: receive and inspect hardware, rack and stack equipment, and run and dress structured cabling to standard.
  • Verify integrator and contractor work against build specifications, drive defects to resolution, and make sure sites are production-ready before handoff.

Break/Fix and Troubleshooting

  • Triage and troubleshoot server hardware using BMC/IPMI, hardware logs, diagnostics and firmware tools. Find the root cause instead of swapping parts until something works.
  • Replace components and whole systems, including servers, switches and optics, safely and with minimal disruption.
  • Troubleshoot Layer 1 and Layer 2 issues: console into network devices, read interface and link state from the command line, inspect and clean optics, check light levels, and test fiber with a light meter or OTDR.

On-Call and Incidents

  • Take part in an on-call rotation and respond on site to incidents affecting hardware at your data center.
  • Document what happened and what you did, and contribute to root-cause analysis and follow-up actions.

AI, Automation and Continuous Improvement

  • Solve problems for good. When an issue repeats, find the underlying cause and change the process, runbook or tooling so it doesn't come back.
  • Use AI tools as part of your daily work: to speed up troubleshooting, interpret hardware and network logs, draft and improve documentation and runbooks, and summarize incidents.
  • Find repetitive manual work and remove it with scripting, automation or AI-assisted workflows, or turn it into clear requirements for tooling teams.
  • Share what works so the rest of the team can adopt it across every site.

Documentation and DCIM

  • Keep DCIM records accurate in real time, including rack elevations, cabling, power and asset location, from receipt through decommissioning.
  • Follow and improve runbooks and build standards so work is repeatable across sites.

Logistics and Hardware Lifecycle

  • Own receiving, shipping and spares inventory at your site, and process RMAs end to end.
  • Perform on-site decommissioning: unracking, serial number verification and chain of custody through handoff for secure destruction.

Vendors, Partners and Compliance

  • Escort and supervise colocation remote-hands staff, contractors and integrators working at your site, and hold them to our quality and safety standards.
  • Work directly with partner teams to coordinate access, maintenance and escalations for your site.
  • Follow physical security, access control and compliance procedures without exception, and help produce accurate evidence for audits.

Supporting Other Sites

  • Support other sites remotely, for example by guiding remote hands or reviewing documentation, and travel occasionally to help with builds or surges.

Who You Are

Careful and precise. Clean cabling, correct labels and accurate records matter to you. If it isn't documented, it isn't done.

Dependable on your own. You're often the only Cloudflare person on site. You work independently, communicate clearly with a remote team, and know when to escalate.

Security-minded. You understand that access rules and chain of custody exist for a reason, and you follow them every time.

A troubleshooter, not a parts swapper. You want to know why something failed, and you use logs, diagnostics and the command line to find out.

Someone who makes the team better. You share what you learn, help newer teammates get up to speed, and take ownership of your site's outcomes.

AI-fluent and automation-first. Your first instinct is to solve a problem for good, not work around it again. You reach for AI tools and automation to troubleshoot faster, document better and improve how the team works, and you check the output before you trust it.

Required Experience

  • Hands-on experience in data center, network or server hardware operations, including working independently on site.
  • Experience racking, stacking and cabling servers and network equipment, and replacing whole systems and components.
  • Solid working knowledge of structured cabling standards, fiber and copper, and optics.
  • Hardware troubleshooting beyond parts swaps, including BMC/IPMI, hardware logs, diagnostics and firmware.
  • Comfort with the Linux command line and with network device CLIs to troubleshoot Layer 1 and Layer 2 issues.
  • Experience with fiber inspection, cleaning and testing, including light meters or OTDR.
  • Regular, hands-on use of AI tools in your technical work, such as troubleshooting, log analysis or documentation, and examples of improving a process instead of repeating a workaround.
  • Experience with asset tracking, DCIM or inventory systems, and with receiving, shipping and RMA processes.
  • Experience working in colocation facilities and with third-party vendors or contractors.
  • Willingness to take part in an on-call rotation and respond on site.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including documenting work and updating tickets.
  • A valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and proximity to your assigned data center.
  • Ability to travel occasionally to other sites.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a technical lead or primary on-site contact for a data center, including leading on-site incident response.
  • Experience mentoring or training other technicians or engineers.
  • Experience writing runbooks, build standards or checklists used across multiple sites.
  • Experience supporting or leading new data center builds or integrated rack deployments.
  • Scripting experience (for example Bash or Python), or experience building automation or AI-assisted workflows that reduced manual work.
  • Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+ or Linux+, CCNA, BICSI, or data center certifications (for example CDCP or CDCTP).
  • Experience with DCIM and source-of-truth tooling such as NetBox or Nlyte, and Jira-based workflows.
  • Experience at a hyperscaler, cloud provider, major CDN or similarly large infrastructure operator.
  • Experience with ITAD and secure destruction processes.

We also consider candidates earlier in their careers who bring strong fundamentals and a drive to learn.

Physical Requirements

  • Lift and move equipment up to 50 lbs, and handle heavier equipment with a team or lift assist.
  • Stand, walk, bend, kneel and work in tight or elevated spaces for extended periods.

Millions of websites, applications, APIs, and AI agents run on Cloudflare, and the traffic we handle for them produces a lot of data. Some customers want to debug applications and investigate security events in Cloudflare. Others want that data in a stack they already trust, such as Splunk, Datadog, Grafana, or their own data lake. Many want both.

We're hiring one Senior Product Manager for each of two areas. You apply once, and we'll work out together which role fits you best.

Observability Platform brings logs, traces, analytics, alerts, and dashboards together in one place, so customers can see what's happening and why. Today most observability ends with a notification, and the customer does the rest. We want a platform that understands the problem, takes action where it can, and asks before doing anything risky.

Telemetry Export delivers Cloudflare's data to the tools customers choose. Logpush handles most of that delivery today, and Workers Observability sends logs and traces over the OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP). Customers want OTLP for the rest of Cloudflare's data, metrics pushed to their own tools, and a way to send us telemetry from workloads that run elsewhere.

Your mission is to make reliability and security something customers rarely have to worry about, with the data they need in Cloudflare or in the tools they already use.

What You'll Do

  • Talk with customers every day and deeply understand their needs. They include developers building on Cloudflare, security teams who feed our logs into a SIEM, and platform teams who run OpenTelemetry pipelines.
  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for your area, and make hard trade-offs between speed, retention, reliability, and cost.
  • Build on open standards like OpenTelemetry, W3C Trace Context, and SQL so teams can keep using the tools they already have.
  • Own the business, including pricing, packaging, and revenue. Measure progress by adoption and reliability.

In Observability Platform, you'll also:

  • Bring every Cloudflare product into one observability experience, so customers can follow a problem from one product to the next without switching tools.
  • Move beyond notifications to workflows that investigate, roll back, or fix problems, with guardrails customers control.
  • Give people and their agents the context they need to act safely, including how services connect and depend on each other.
  • Own the experience end to end, from first setup to the middle of an incident or an audit.

In Telemetry Export, you'll also:

  • Bring Logpush, Workers Logpush, and the OpenTelemetry destinations in Workers Observability together as one product, and keep existing integrations working.
  • Ship metrics export and extend OTLP delivery to more of our datasets. Own the intake path for telemetry from outside Cloudflare; Observability Platform will store and query it.
  • Make delivery something customers can trust, so they can see whether their data arrived, get a useful alert when it didn't, and know how to recover.
  • Help customers filter and transform data before it's sent, so they export only what they need.

Who You Are

  • You've shipped products people depend on, as a PM, engineer, engineering manager, SRE, or founder, and you can point to what changed because of your work.
  • You move fast and own outcomes. You find the most important problem, get the team behind it, ship, and measure.
  • You are a builder at heart. You love getting to a deep understanding of customer needs, and shipping things that help them accomplish their goals. You are passionate about the Observability industry and want to be on the forefront of innovating what it can turn into.
  • You understand how telemetry systems fail, whether that's a delivery pipeline under backpressure or a query that scans far more data than it needs, and you can explain the reliability and cost trade-offs to engineers and to customers.
  • AI is already central to how you work. You use it to prototype ideas and dig through data, and you have a view on how agents will produce telemetry and act on it.

Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • You've relied on observability yourself, on call during an outage or in a security investigation, and you know where today's tools fall short.
  • You've run or built on telemetry pipelines such as the OpenTelemetry Collector, Vector, Fluent Bit, or Kafka, or you've ingested someone else's data at scale at a vendor.
  • You notice friction, like a confusing error message or a query that takes too many steps, and you fix it.
  • You've priced a usage-based product, and you know what happens when existing customers start paying for something that used to be included.
  • You're comfortable with enterprise customers, whether you're talking about compliance with a security team or OTLP with a platform engineer.
  • You write clearly enough to get teams across Cloudflare to agree on a plan, and you can translate between what customers need and what engineering builds.

Compensation
Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

  • For Colorado based hires: Estimated annual salary of $156,000 - $195,000
  • For San Francisco / Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $179,000 - $224,000
  • For New York City/Seattle based hires: Estimated annual salary of $172,000 - $215,000
  • For Lisbon based hires: Estimated annual salary of €68,000 to €85,000

Equity
This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits
Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Commuter Spending Accounts
  • Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
  • On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
  • Global Travel Medical Insurance

Time Off

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

  • Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives. 
  • Revenue Acumen: Demonstrated success owning and forecasting a revenue number, preferably in an enterprise B2B SaaS or infrastructure environment. Deep understanding of enterprise sales cycles, SaaS metrics, ACV, renewal, and expansion motions.
  • Leadership & Coaching: Excellent people management skills with the ability to coach technical sellers through complex deals, difficult conversations, and career growth. Comfortable giving direct, actionable feedback.

A new generation of companies is building AI models, agents, AI apps and developer tools, and many of them can go from seed funding to global scale in under two years. Cloudflare wants to be the platform they build, run and secure on from their first line of code through their IPO.

As the Senior Regional Sales Director, Startups – East, you will lead the managers and Account Executives (AEs) covering venture-backed AI and digital native companies across the eastern U.S., including New York, Boston, the DC area, Atlanta and Miami. You'll own revenue, hiring and Cloudflare's reputation in the East Coast startup and venture community, while keeping the Cloudflare culture. This role suits builders who like speed, technical buyers and the challenge of turning fast usage growth into lasting, multi-million-dollar customer relationships.

You'll set strategy for the region and lead a team that sells to founders, CTOs and heads of engineering and infrastructure. Your team will:

  • Move fast deals forward without losing sight of the long-term account
  • Turn companies already on Cloudflare's free and pay-as-you-go plans into committed contracts
  • Work with Product, Developer Speedboat, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success and the Cloudflare for Startups program to make Cloudflare the default choice for AI-native builders

Success means startups that love Cloudflare and recommend it, have grown alongside us from early stage to scale, and run their most important workloads on our Developer Platform, AI products, application security and network.

  • Drive revenue growth across new customers, expansion and conversion of pay-as-you-go accounts to contracts. Build a sales motion where usage growth opens the door to the next use case.

  • Make venture investors a growth channel. Build relationships with VC firms, accelerators and startup programs across the East Coast, working with the Cloudflare for Startups and Workers Launchpad teams to bring in companies at the earliest stages.
  • Help shape the product roadmap. Bring what AI-native customers need back to Product and Engineering, and run design-partner relationships with leading startups that influence what Cloudflare builds next.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Account Executive to join our Enterprise/Field Sales team. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).

As an Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Revenue Generation: Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.
  • Expert Pipeline & Forecasting: Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.
  • Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding: Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.
  • Multi-Engagement Leadership: Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.
  • Virtual Team Leadership: Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Frontier labs hire former CTOs as senior Members of Technical Staff: high-impact individual contributors tasked with solving the hardest problems without the overhead of team management. This role applies that model to go-to-market. We are seeking former sales leaders and founders to own Cloudflare's Developer Platform growth inside a select portfolio of the most important technology companies in the world.

As a Strategic Account Director, you will own the long-term Developer Platform strategy and consumption growth for one to three of Cloudflare's top 10 accounts including frontier AI labs and the most innovative software companies. Over time, the largest of these accounts will move to a dedicated 1:1 model. You'll partner with the account team to guide strategic decisions, lead engagement with key executives, and bring developer fluency married to deep business acumen.

You'll collaborate as a peer with Cloudflare's sales leadership and work closely with Solutions Architects, Forward-Deployed Engineers, and Product. You are fluent in both developer workloads and commercial mechanics. You can set a multi-year account strategy in the morning and work through a live deal in the afternoon.

What You Will Do

  • Architect the account strategy. Build and execute a multi-year Developer Platform plan for each account: defining priority workloads, how adoption grows, competitive position, and the commercial path to get there.
  • Accelerate the customer journey (drive activation → expansion → commercial structure): Use usage telemetry to find next-best actions, expansion paths, and risks. Remove technical, commercial, and organizational blockers so real workloads land and scale.
  • Structure strategic deals. Work with the account executive, Deal Desk, Pricing, Finance, and Legal to design commit structures and consumption-based agreements that match how the customer actually builds. Compete credibly against hyperscalers and other platforms.
  • Lead executive engagement. Build trusted relationships with CTOs and heads of infrastructure, AI, and engineering, as well as the commercial decision makers. Run impactful executive business reviews and leverage Cloudflare leadership at the right moments.
  • Mobilize Cloudflare. Align the account team, Solutions Architects, FDEs, Product, and Support on the account's priorities, establishing clear owners and driving flawless follow-through. Run GTM motions in step with the workloads where we've proven fit.
  • Close the loop with Product. Turn what you see in the account into clear, quantified recommendations on positioning, packaging, limits, and roadmap.
  • Elevate the field: Turn your account experience into workload blueprints, deal patterns, and playbooks. Coach sales leaders and account teams in a train-the-trainer model to scale your impact globally..

  • 12+ years in technology sales, including senior sales leadership (Director, VP, or CRO) or strategic named-account roles at developer-platform or consumption-based companies, such as AWS, GCP, Vercel, MongoDB, Databricks, Snowflake, or an AI lab.
  • A track record of growing consumption and revenue in large, complex, highly technical accounts over consecutive years.
  • Executive presence and credibility with C-level and VP audiences at the fastest-moving technology companies.
  • The ability to turn technical workloads into compelling commercial outcomes, and to navigate complex deal approvals with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Security.
  • Deep experience with usage-based pricing and commit structures.
  • Analytical rigor: you can read product usage telemetry and size opportunities at the level of Sheets or SQL.
  • A clear persuasive writer and presenter, equally effective with developer ICs and executive sponsors.
  • A builder's mindset: you lead through influence and get cross-functional work done without relying on hierarchy.

  • Experience selling to, or working inside, frontier AI labs or AI-native companies.
  • Familiarity with AI infrastructure workloads such as inference, agents, sandboxed code execution, large-scale storage, and globally distributed apps.
  • Former startup CROs, sales leaders, and founders who thrive in hands-on environments
  • Hands-on familiarity with Cloudflare's Developer Platform.

  • Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

I.N.T.E.R.D.I.C.T. (Identify, Neutralize, Triage, Engage, Respond, Disrupt, Integrate, Contain, Threat Hunting) is Cloudforce One's unified operational security organization responsible for identifying, analyzing, and responding to threats targeting Cloudflare and its customers. INTERDICT encompasses three main sub-functions:

  • Cloudflare Managed Defense (CMD): Network and application security monitoring for 'Under Attack' mitigation support.
  • PhishGuard: Managed email threat detection and response service.
  • Detection Engineering: ML model development and detection optimization.

  • Adhere to and champion strict customer SLAs for alert response times, event analysis, and clear executive reporting.
  • Mentor and elevate Tier 1 and Tier 2 engineers through structured shadowing, technical post-mortems, and internal training.
  • Partner with internal Engineering and Product teams to translate operational attack trends into prioritized platform enhancements, tool feedback, and automated detection logic.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Hands-on experience defending against advanced persistent threats (APTs), credential stuffing, scraping botnets, or application-layer bypass attacks against major CDNs/WAFs.

Cloudflare’s Developer Platform has a more recognizable point of view and a clearer place in the developer and AI ecosystem. You will bring those efforts together, with clear ownership from initial disclosure through verified remediation.

- Build repeatable capabilities for safe exploit validation, mitigation, patch qualification, and fleet-wide remediation.

- Coordinate managed WAF response with SRA, Managed Rules, Firewall/ERE, and WAF engineering while preserving specialist ownership.

- Maintain strong review, staged-release, health-monitoring, and rollback practices—including during urgent response.

- Turn recurring response problems into durable engineering improvements rather than repeated manual coordination.

### Develop responsible AI-assisted operations

- Build AI-assisted workflows for triage, research, exposure analysis, drafting, and release tracking.

- Establish replay evaluations, measurable quality thresholds, access controls, and human approval gates before production use.

- Keep release authority, disclosure approval, risk acceptance, and other consequential decisions with accountable people.

- Measure actual operational benefit and failure rates rather than assuming productivity gains.

Set direction and communicate clearly

- Define and report response metrics, including time to assess exposure, mitigate, patch, and verify remediation.

- Translate technical uncertainty into clear decisions, priorities, and executive updates.

- Partner with Product Security, Legal, Communications, and engineering leaders on coordinated disclosure and customer communication.

- A practical understanding of mitigation, patching, exploitation detection, and remediation verification—and the differences between them.

- Experience establishing safe deployment, validation, and rollback practices at scale.

- The ability to recruit and develop strong engineers while remaining credible in technical reviews and operational decisions.

- Clear written communication and the ability to work effectively with engineers, security specialists, executives, and legal partners.

- A thoughtful approach to AI-assisted engineering, including evaluation, security boundaries, and human accountability.

- Coordinating responses to embargoed vulnerabilities or working with upstream maintainers and security researchers.

- Kernel patching, backporting, runtime or trust-store remediation, or large-scale dependency updates.

- WAF rule development or deployment, exploit reproduction, host forensics, or threat hunting.

- Building artifact inventories, dependency graphs, or software provenance systems.

- Developing and operating AI-assisted engineering tools with rigorous evaluation and access controls.

- Building a new team or function while maintaining effective partnerships with existing owners.

- Exposure questions are answered quickly with evidence rather than repeated manual investigation.

- Urgent fixes move faster without bypassing production safety or disclosure controls.

- Cloudflare can distinguish between an exploit being blocked, a vulnerability being patched, and a compromise being removed.

- AI-assisted workflows deliver demonstrated value within explicit safeguards.

- The team’s capabilities and staffing evolve based on measured demand and outcomes.

Cloudflare’s Engineering Team builds and runs the software that handles trillions of requests per month. Product development covers both new features and functionality and scaling our existing software to meet the challenges of a massively growing customer base.

The Cloudflare Zero Trust group within the Engineering organization is taking on the mission of ensuring the people and teams within an organization can access the tools they need to do their job safe from malware and other online threats with the speed and reliability that Cloudflare is known for.

What you’ll do


In this role, you’ll help us build Cloudflare’s Data Loss Prevention (DLP)  product that helps customers of any size protect the data that powers their business. Whether credit card numbers, health records, trade secrets or other types of data, Cloudflare’s solution allows organizations to focus on their business and stop worrying about applying bandaids to protect their data. Digital Native SEs at Cloudflare work with the most innovative and cutting-edge companies on the planet — the startups and high-growth, cloud-native businesses that are building the next generation of Internet products. The Pre-Sales Solution Engineering organization owns the technical sales of the Cloudflare solution portfolio, ensuring maximal business value, fit-for-purpose solution design and adoption roadmap for our customers. You have experience in a pre-sales or other technical customer-facing role, and you're at your best when engaging directly with engineering teams and technical founders. In this role you'll partner closely with the sales team from the very start of the cycle — joining early discovery calls, qualifying opportunities from the get-go, and embedding yourself in customer Slack channels and working sessions. You'll lead technical discovery, deliver compelling demos and architecture discussions, run proof-of-concept builds, and evangelize the Cloudflare Developer Platform as the foundation for our customers' next products and AI initiatives.

  • Identify and map customer initiatives and business problems — especially around new product development and AI initiatives — to the Cloudflare platform.
  • Build relationships and technical champions within customer accounts, from founding engineers and developers up to the CTO.
  • Develop and present tailored technical content and demos for both hands-on developer audiences and senior technical leadership.
  • Lead demo and proof-of-concept / build activities for Cloudflare prospects and customers.
  • Evangelize the Cloudflare Developer Platform (Workers, Workers AI, Durable Objects, R2, D1, KV, Vectorize, Queues, Pages and more) — making the case for customers to build on Cloudflare, not just use it for storage or CDN.
  • Demonstrate your expertise with your peers through the creation of professional content, including reference architectures, demos, blog posts and other knowledge-sharing activities.
  • Represent and evangelize Cloudflare externally at Developer, Community, Technology and Industry events with thought leadership and expertise.
  • Apply in-depth vertical knowledge or domain expertise. Advise on best practices.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Previous experience as a Solutions Engineer or other customer-facing technical role, ideally selling to or working with developer-led, cloud-native, or startup organizations.
  • A genuine "builder" mindset and the personality to match: you enjoy talking to developers, you're curious, and you naturally gravitate toward technical problem-solving conversations.
  • The ability to speak engineers' language credibly — you can hold your own on architecture, APIs, and platform design — without this being a hands-on, code-every-day developer role.
  • Strong technical discovery instincts: you know how to draw out requirements, qualify fit early, and separate real needs from noise.
  • A good mix of pre-sales / technical sales experience and comfort operating in an agile, fast-moving environment (joining Slack channels, iterating quickly, engaging in early-stage calls, and qualifying deals from the start).
  • Solid communication, written and presentation skills, with the range to talk to both a hands-on developer and a CTO in the same day.
  • Ability to work on several projects and activities concurrently.
  • Highly driven, curious, team-oriented, and able to work with a sense of urgency.
  • You've built web applications before, or contributed to existing web applications in a meaningful way — enough to have real empathy for how developers work.
  • Polished communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to drive a discussion with a broad range of stakeholders (from the web developer to the CTO/CISO).
  • Relationship building: a proven track record of building deep technical relationships with engineers and technical founders. Experience managing various stakeholder relationships to build consensus on technical solutions/projects.

    • Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.
    • Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.
    • Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.

Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.

  • Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms.
