Team Mission

The Security Incident Response Team’s mission is to systematically respond to security threats safeguarding Cloudflare. We operate 24/7 across the globe to respond to security incidents, continuously improve our response capabilities, lead digital investigations and enhance our overall security posture. Our “Cloudflare on Cloudflare”, data and automation first philosophy makes us a cohesive team with high impact. 

The Role

This intermediate Security Engineer role on the Security Response Team (SIRT) focuses on leading security incidents and engineering scalable response capabilities across enterprise security,vulnerability response, insider threat and privacy incidents. Incident command is a core responsibility, requiring coordination of technical investigations, containment, remediation, and stakeholder communications. This role collaborates with IT, Engineering, Product, Product Security, Detection Engineering, Privacy, and Legal teams, leveraging programming, security telemetry, and AI-powered tools to improve response effectiveness. It requires clear communication of technical findings and business impact, alongside participation in a shared on-call rotation with rotating weekend and holiday shifts.

  • Investigate real-time security incidents, working closely with detection teams to validate alerts and escalate threats.
  • Conduct post-incident analysis to determine root causes, document findings, and recommend mitigation strategies.

Security Monitoring & Continuous Threat Analysis

  • Oversee security monitoring operations, ensuring alert triage, enrichment, and validation align with investigative workflows.
  • Optimize SIEM queries, log ingestion pipelines, and case management systems to improve threat visibility.
  • Develop playbooks and workflows to streamline investigations and reduce manual effort in repetitive tasks.
  • Maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for effective response to security alerts and ongoing monitoring.
  • Collaborate with the Detection Engineering team to refine detection rules and investigative signals based on real-world attack patterns.

  • Engineer automated solutions to enhance investigation efficiency, such as log parsing scripts, data enrichment tools, and case correlation frameworks.
  • Build log analysis pipelines for efficient parsing, enrichment, and correlation of multi-source security data.
  • Develop custom detection logic for brute-force attempts, lateral movement, and anomaly-based intrusion detection.
  • Automate threat intelligence enrichment, real-time event processing, and security data visualization.
  • Engineer scalable solutions for PCAP analysis, network flow monitoring, and cloud security event detection.

  • Perform disk, memory, and network forensics to uncover hidden indicators of compromise (IOCs) and attacker behaviors.
  • Correlate multi-source logs (firewall, EDR, web, authentication logs, cloud telemetry) to reconstruct attack chains and identify attacker footholds.
  • Analyze network traffic to detect exfiltration attempts, lateral movement, and suspicious patterns.
  • Use threat intelligence tooling (opencti) to enrich investigations and automate IOC processing.

  • 3+ years of experience in incident response, security operations, and forensic analysis
  • Proven ability to lead crisis situations, make data-driven security decisions, and drive technical and operational improvements.
  • Strong expertise in incident management, root cause analysis, and forensic investigation methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM (SQL, ELK, etc), SOAR, and EDR  for real-time security monitoring and response.
  • Experience managing large-scale security incidents, ensuring effective escalation, resolution, and business alignment.
  • Strong understanding of threat intelligence, attacker tactics (MITRE ATT&CK), and real-world attack chains.
  • Familiarity with SOAR platforms and security case management automation.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Certifications: GCFA, GNFA, GREM, GCIH, or equivalent forensic/security certifications.
  • Experience in Red Teaming, Threat Intelligence, or Malware Analysis.
  • Understanding of cloud-native security monitoring (AWS, GCP, Azure).

About the Team

The Developer GTM organization is driving how we attract, inspire, and grow the next generation of builders. We are redefining what developer acquisition looks like in a world where AI and distributed agents are reshaping the stack. Our mission is to lead the transformation of Cloudflare GTM into a Cloud Platform that has roots and capabilities in application services and cybersecurity. We create new pathways for developers to discover Cloudflare, whether through ecosystem partnerships, high-impact content, or creative field engagement and enablement.

We are builders, storytellers, and connectors united by one goal: to make Cloudflare the best place for developers to build.

The Developer GTM organization partners tightly with Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, RevOps, and Marketing. Developer GTM connects developer activation to durable commercial outcomes: shaping usage into clear proposals, aligning pricing and packaging, enabling the field with repeatable motions, and feeding real-world signals back into Product.

About the Role

Startups are where the next great companies, and the next great Cloudflare accounts, are born. The builders choosing their infrastructure stack today at seed and Series A will be running production workloads at massive scale in three to five years. We need a leader who has lived that journey firsthand.

We are hiring a Head of Startups to own Cloudflare's Developer Platform GTM strategy for the startup segment. Unlike traditional programs-operations roles, which are managed by our dedicated Startup Programs team, this role acts as the strategic GTM leader who sets the vision for how Cloudflare wins with startups, builds deep relationships across the VC and accelerator ecosystem, and drives the commercial trajectory from first developer sign-up through expansion and committed spend.

You will combine your ecosystem fluency with rigorous GTM execution to build repeatable motions, enable the field, and translate startup signals into actionable recommendations for Product and Pricing. 

We are looking for someone who has been in the founder's seat. A former CRO or co-founder who has raised venture capital, navigated board dynamics, and understands what startup CTOs and CEOs actually care about when choosing infrastructure. You bring instant credibility with founders and VCs because you have been one. Who You Are

  • Deep fluency in the VC ecosystem: You understand the firms, broad dynamics, and exactly what drives infrastructure decisions in venture-backed companies.
  • 10+ years in technology sales or GTM, with significant time in startup and developer-platform ecosystems.

  • Fluent in usage-based and consumption pricing models, as well as startup-stage commercial mechanics: credits, usage ramps, free-tier conversion, and early commit structures.
  • Data-driven and analytical. Comfortable with product usage telemetry and Sheets/SQL-level analysis to size opportunities, identify high-potential accounts, and measure impact.
  • A builder's mindset: you lead through influence, get cross-functional work done without relying on hierarchy, and thrive in fast-moving environments with ambiguity.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with AI-native startups or AI infrastructure workloads such as inference, agents, sandboxed code execution, and globally distributed applications.
  • Prior experience building or leading startup ecosystem programs at a developer-platform or cloud company.
  • Hands-on familiarity with Cloudflare's Developer Platform.

Cloudflare is redefining the way networks are run at scale, and some of the largest networks in the world now run their traffic through us. Cloudflare's network runs in hundreds of cities on general-purpose Linux servers, not dedicated routers, so the routers, firewalls, load balancers, and proxies that carry our customers' traffic are software that we write, ship, and operate ourselves.

Our Packet Processing team builds and operates that software: high-performance code that processes customer traffic at the packet level as it moves through Cloudflare's network, in every Cloudflare data center. That includes the L4 load balancer at the front door of every server, a per-customer routing and forwarding data plane, a stateful network firewall, and a TCP/UDP reverse proxy (the engines behind products like Magic Transit, Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare Network Firewall, and Spectrum).

We are a team of engineers who obsess over performance, correctness, and reliability at massive scale. We own what we build in production, a lot of our work happens close to the kernel and the NIC.

About the role

For us, performance is a product feature. Customers notice single-flow throughput, packet loss, and latency right away, and every CPU cycle we spend on a packet is multiplied across every server in our network. We're looking for engineers who love finding out where the time goes, and then making it go away.

Some of the things you'd work on:

  • Pushing single large flows (e.g., one tunnel carrying a customer's whole data center) to multiple Gbps and beyond, and making that performance consistent
  • Finding out exactly where packets get dropped and why: NIC queues, interrupts and softirq, XDP, veth and namespaces, userspace rings, and everything in between
  • CPU placement: NUMA, RSS, core isolation, and steering traffic to the right cores on servers that also run many other services
  • Cutting the CPU cost per packet in hot paths written in Rust, C, and Go: batching, cache-friendly data structures, fewer copies, fewer locks
  • Measuring all of it: profiling with perf, eBPF tracing, and flame graphs; continuous profiling across the fleet; benchmarks in the lab and careful experiments in production
  • Building the benchmark and test tooling that keeps performance regressions from shipping
  • Helping shape a unified data plane platform so that it's fast from the start

We write mostly Go and Rust (plus C for eBPF) on Linux, and the work ranges from NIC configuration and the kernel network stack to userspace packet pipelines.

Create demand rather than relying on inbound opportunities, and consistently bring significant new logos onto the Cloudflare platform.

Named Account Planning: Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-year account plans for priority net-new targets and selected existing Named accounts. Identify whitespace, business initiatives, power structures, buying processes, competitive dynamics, and potential entry points. Continuously assess account potential and concentrate time and resources on the accounts and opportunities with the greatest potential for platform-wide adoption.

Executive Relationship Management: Build trusted relationships at CISO, CIO, CTO, and board level, often starting without an existing Cloudflare presence. Develop broad, multi-threaded executive networks within target Named accounts and act as a trusted advisor by bringing relevant market insight, a compelling point of view, and clear business value—not simply responding to RFPs.

Complex Sales Cycle Leadership: Lead sophisticated enterprise sales processes from initial engagement through contract signature. Navigate technical, security, legal, procurement, financial, and executive buying centres simultaneously. Establish clear mutual action plans, maintain control of deal momentum, qualification, and next steps, and advance opportunities with precision and appropriate urgency.

Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding: Develop a thorough understanding of each prospect’s technology environment, including cloud strategy, network architecture, security posture, application landscape, data sovereignty, regulatory requirements, and AI infrastructure. Map Cloudflare’s platform capabilities to these environments through relevant Reference Architectures, positioning comprehensive platform adoption rather than isolated point solutions.

Align resources around a differentiated strategy, proactively remove blockers, and deliver a consistently excellent prospect experience throughout the sales cycle.

AI-Powered Sales Execution: Use AI tools deliberately and consistently to improve the quality and velocity of your sales execution. Apply them to account research and prioritisation, hypothesis development, stakeholder mapping, personalised executive outreach, meeting preparation, competitive analysis, pipeline inspection, and follow-up. Continuously experiment with new ways to make your Named-account management and customer engagement sharper and more effective.

Digital Transformation & AI Positioning: Serve as a credible partner to enterprises navigating digital, cloud, security, and AI-driven transformation. Understand how AI adoption is reshaping infrastructure, compliance, security, and competitive dynamics. Position Cloudflare capabilities—including AI Gateway, Workers AI, and Zero Trust for AI workloads—as strategic enablers of customers’ long-term transformation agendas.

Expert Pipeline & Forecasting: Build and maintain sufficient high-quality pipeline across your Named-account portfolio to consistently achieve ambitious new business targets. Deliver accurate, evidence-based account and opportunity forecasts to sales leadership, with clear visibility into qualification, deal status, risks, stakeholder alignment, and required actions. Apply rigorous inspection and honest judgement across long and complex enterprise sales cycles.

Advanced Negotiation & Closure: Lead complex commercial and contractual negotiations with confidence and discipline. Construct compelling, outcome-linked value propositions tied directly to each customer’s business objectives. Secure commercially strong, sustainable agreements while protecting long-term customer value and Cloudflare’s position as a strategic platform partner.

Trusted Advisor & Organisational Contribution: Share field intelligence, competitive insight, and winning practices openly across the German and wider international teams. Contribute to Cloudflare’s understanding of the German Named-account market, partner with colleagues to improve execution, and elevate the performance of those around you through coaching, collaboration, and example.

  • A consistent history of personal pipeline generation within assigned account portfolios, including disciplined prospecting, executive outreach, account-based selling, and effective use of partners and industry networks to access senior decision-makers.
  • Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security (Zero Trust, SASE, SSE), Connectivity, Developer Platforms, and Edge Computing, with the ability to engage credibly with CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and senior infrastructure leaders.
  • Proven ability to understand complex enterprise IT architectures and map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures, connecting technical differentiation to measurable business outcomes and platform-wide adoption.
  • Demonstrated success navigating complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles across procurement, legal, information security, technical, financial, and executive buying centres.
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools in a sales context, such as prospect research, account prioritisation, executive outreach personalisation, account planning, stakeholder mapping, meeting preparation, or pipeline management. You can explain specifically how AI has made you faster, sharper, or more effective.
  • Familiarity with AI transformation trends and their infrastructure, security, sovereignty, and compliance implications, with the ability to position Cloudflare’s AI platform capabilities as strategic enablers for large enterprises.

About the Department

Cloudflare helps build a better Internet and the Emerging Technology and Incubation (ETI) team invents, launches, and brings to market new technologies built on Cloudflare's network. ETI makes dozens of bets on the future of the Internet and takes the ones that work to market.

ETI started in 2016 and incubated several of Cloudflare's major product lines, including Zero Trust and the Developer Platform. Today ETI is focused on the agentic Internet: how AI agents find, read, and pay for content and services, and how creators and companies get paid as agents become a larger share of Internet traffic.

Every bet in ETI follows the same loop: test an idea, build the smallest version that tells us something, get real feedback, iterate, and ship. The team moves quickly and works closely with teams across Cloudflare.

About the Role

You will be Chief of Staff to the head of ETI, working alongside the product managers and engineering leaders on each bet. You will help the head of ETI stay high level while you handle much of the execution. You will be read in on almost everything in the portfolio, so discretion matters. Over time, you will represent them in meetings.

Operations and Strategic Initiatives: Lead the strategic initiatives that start in ETI or rely on the ETI team. These can include acquisition due diligence and integration, partnerships that extend Cloudflare's technology to new customers, and anything else the portfolio needs. Build the tooling and workflows ETI is missing, thinking through the dependencies.

Team and Project Management: Run the operating rhythm with the teams. Drive decisions and plans to closure, follow through on what is owed, and prep and close out the big moments such as planning cycles, onsites, and key forums. The teams will trust you to help set priorities across the group and to own new projects or dependencies. You will partner with the executive assistant, who handles booking, expenses, and logistics, while you help prioritize the calendar.

Research and Analysis: Get into the details with the teams: research and analysis, solving problems, and producing the docs and materials the head of ETI needs while keeping them human. You will be a real sounding board, with useful commentary and feedback.

Communications: Help ETI tell its story, internally and, with the Communications team, externally. Own the presentations and materials ETI shares, including retrospectives and celebrations, and help the product, engineering, and marketing teams get the inputs they need to tell specific stories.

Who you are

A suitable candidate gets into the details and understands them while keeping the high-level view, figures out ways to make things work, and communicates with grace and empathy inside and outside of Cloudflare. You work independently and ask for help when you need it. You solve thorny problems by getting to first principles and then aligning the team on the goal; executing, learning, and adapting.

  • Gets into the weeds and really understands the details, while keeping the high-level perspective
  • Systems minded: thinks through dependencies and how the pieces fit together
  • High agency: figures out ways to make things work
  • Deeply curious: wants to know how and why the world works and is always learning
  • Learns enough about how the Internet, crypto, and business work to give useful insight and make decisions on their own
  • Builds well with LLMs, even if not a developer, shown by clear communication, structured thinking, and ownership of tasks
  • Works comfortably with senior leaders and handles confidential information with discretion
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A high degree of attention to detail
  • The ability to work in a fast-moving and ever-changing environment
  • A desire to receive feedback and grow

Application Deadline: February 21, 2027

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

  • For SF, SJ, and Bay Area Metro based hires: Estimated annual salary of $216,000 - $297,000.

  • For Boston, California - Remote, Connecticut - Remote, DC Metro, Massachusetts - Remote, New Jersey - Remote, New York City, NY Metro, Remote - Washington, Washington (Kirkland), and Washington D.C. based hires: Estimated annual salary of $207,000 - $285,000.

  • For Colorado - Remote, Illinois - Remote, Maryland - Remote, Minnesota - Remote, Nevada - Remote, New York - Remote, Rhode Island - Remote, and Vermont - Remote based hires: Estimated annual salary of $188,000 - $259,000.

  • This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.

Benefits

  • Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! You are approachable, adaptable, and comfortable leading live meetings with both internal stakeholders and external vendors to work through redlines and resolve issues. You are also AI friendly and naturally curious about using modern tools to simplify everyday tasks like reviewing clauses, summarizing agreements, and spotting bottlenecks. You enjoy tracking metrics, pay close attention to the details, and stay calm and professional when deadlines get tight.

Key Functions

  • Draft, review, redline, and negotiate a wide variety of commercial agreements, including SaaS, technology, internet infrastructure, security, and data privacy contracts.
  • Lead meetings and live negotiation calls with internal business owners, Commercial Legal, and external vendors to work through sticking points and get contracts signed.
  • Use AI tools and workflow automations to speed up daily contracting work, improve accuracy, and share new ways to make the broader team more efficient.
  • Spot and reduce contractual, legal, and commercial risks by reviewing terms carefully and partnering with Legal, Privacy, and Security.
  • Work with internal teams and suppliers to resolve contract issues after signature, manage renewals and amendments, and support vendor performance reviews.
  • Manage contracts from intake through execution in our contract management system, keeping records clean, following company policies, and tracking key metrics.

• Location: Remote (EU based, GMT timezone)
  • Department: Engineering
  • Employment Type: Contract
  • Contract Length: 6 months (with potential for extension)

About YLD:

Our goal is to help our clients keep moving forward. We work with them to build the skills and capabilities they need to stay ahead of the competition, and we know our success only happens when they succeed. We’re a team of curious, talented people, and we’re committed to making YLD a place where great people want to work, grow, and stay.

We’re a remote-first consultancy specialising in software engineering, product design, and data. Our teams are based across London, Lisbon, and Porto, and we create digital solutions that continue to deliver value long after our work is done.

About the role:

As a Senior Software Engineer at YLD, you’ll be part of a client team building innovative products. We’re looking for someone curious, passionate, driven, and enthusiastic. You should be skilled in problem-solving and experienced in designing scalable, resilient, and fault-tolerant architectures. You’re also an effective communicator and a strong team player. Together with your team, you’ll thrive in a fast-paced engineering environment, delivering outstanding results and exciting projects.

Preferred Skills:

  • Strong backend engineering experience, with Go as a primary or preferred language;
  • Comfortable working in cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud;
  • Experience building and maintaining APIs and backend services, including SaaS platforms;
  • Familiarity with modern infrastructure and distributed systems;
  • Solid understanding of modern deployment practices, including Docker, containers, and Kubernetes;
  • Strong background in testing strategies, including TDD, across the full system lifecycle, with a focus on performance optimization;
  • Use AI tools to augment your work, applying sound judgement to adopt emerging technologies where they genuinely add value and increase your impact as an engineer.

You should apply if you are:

  • Self-motivated, proactive and always looking for ways to improve and develop yourself;
  • A good communicator, both in writing and verbally. You’ll be able to explain technical ideas and concepts in business-friendly language;
  • Detail-oriented;
  • Possess strong problem-solving skills that balance innovation with pragmatic technology choices to solve business needs;
  • Used to working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment;
  • Analytical and problem-solving-oriented;
  • A genuine believer in diversity and fairness.

What you’ll get in return:

  • The chance to work with a forward-thinking, ethical, and fun group of people and to develop and grow your skills in a fast-moving business

Our typical recruitment process:

  • 1st Interview with a Talent Partner (30/45 mins)
  • Technical Interview with our Senior Developers (1h30)
  • Final chat with our Client Partner (30/45 mins)

Get a glimpse of what it's like working at YLD! 🤳

Check out our LinkedIn page

We live and breathe our values, and know you will too:

  • Growing every day
  • Including everyone
  • Relationships built on honesty and ethics
  • Inspiring solutions
  • Winning together

We’re an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity in all its forms. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity, age, marital status, or disability. We also offer a remote-first working environment, with flexible working and work–life balance as standard for all employees.

collectedJobs.descriptionText:
YLD is a software engineering and product design consultancy, founded in 2013 based in London, Lisbon and Porto.

We work with engineering and product leaders who know what good looks like and are frustrated by the gap between strategy and execution. We embed senior engineers and designers inside client teams, working in their codebase, their tooling, their delivery rhythm. AI runs through how our teams work, and we help clients adopt it into their own workflows too.

About the role:

We're building out data as a first-class practice at YLD, and we need someone in London who can be the credible technical voice in front of clients and prospects, not just describing what we could do, but backing it with real delivery experience.

This is a senior role, reporting to our Head of Engineering. You'll sit alongside our commercial and client services leadership in meetings where technical credibility matters, help shape and win new engagements, and stay close enough to client work to guide it and step in yourself when an engagement needs you. Alongside, we expect you to build our external reputation in data through events, writing, and the wider community.

About you:

You've been a strong data engineer or data lead for years, and you're comfortable in front of a client as well as in a pull request. You know what good data work looks like well enough to spot it, or its absence, in the first ten minutes of a client conversation. You've probably led a team before. Consultancy background is a strong plus, but not essential if you've got real client or stakeholder exposure elsewhere.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will look like this:

Hands-on delivery (core, from day one)

  • Doing hands-on data engineering work directly, pipelines, transformation layers, models, and the infrastructure around them, not just guiding others
  • Adapting to different client contexts: legacy warehouse migrations, greenfield lakehouses, transformation layers that need rescuing
  • Guiding the wider team and unblocking hard technical problems as your remit grows beyond your own delivery
  • Defining and evolving our internal standards for data work: testing, documentation, project structure, code review
  • Mentoring and growing data engineers across the company

Client and commercial (core, from day one)

  • Joining client and prospect meetings as the technical authority on data, alongside our client services and commercial leads
  • Shaping proposals and pitches, translating client problems into a credible data approach and a defensible scope
  • Acting as the escalation point on live data engagements when technical judgement calls need weight behind them
  • Travelling to client sites for workshops, discovery sessions, and in-person relationship building, and representing YLD at external data events

Practice, talent, and external profile (growth, over the first year)

  • Owning the growth of YLD's data practice: capability, reputation, and headcount over time
  • Contributing to attracting and hiring strong data engineers into YLD
  • Representing YLD at data events and in the wider community as your standing in the market builds
  • Supporting our sales team so that data becomes something we can proactively sell, not just respond to

You'll have the following skills and experience:

Leadership and commercial

  • Consulting or agency experience is a strong plus, but real client or stakeholder-facing exposure elsewhere is acceptable
  • A track record of technical leadership: leading a team or function
  • Comfortable presenting to senior client stakeholders and holding your own under commercial pressure
  • Cross-functional fluency: you translate engineering constraints into business terms and negotiate realistic commitments
  • Appetite to build a public presence in the data community over time, even if you don't have one yet

Technical

Not theoretical, evidenced by things you've actually shipped, and deep enough to set the bar for a team and answer a sceptical client:

  • SQL as engineering: read and review SQL that performs at scale, and understand query planning, engine quirks, and how materialisation choices affect cost and performance well enough to guide a team's decisions
  • Python for data: built and maintained production data systems in typed, testable Python, not just notebooks, and can set that standard for others
  • Data modelling: made deliberate choices between dimensional, Data Vault, normalised and denormalised designs, and can explain the trade-offs in flexibility, query performance, and maintainability to both engineers and clients
  • Transformation architecture: design transformations that are idempotent, incremental, and dependency-aware. You think in DAGs, not scripts
  • Pipeline design: weigh batch, streaming, and micro-batch trade-offs against latency, complexity, cost, and reprocessability, and pick the right approach for the problem
  • Data testing: know what to catch at build time (schema contracts, assertions, transformation logic) versus defer to observability, and can make that call for a team
  • Data observability: treat data reliability like site reliability, with measurable indicators, alerting, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • CI/CD for data: version, test, and deploy pipelines like software, with environment promotion, rollback strategies, and infrastructure as code
  • Data governance: implemented lineage, cataloguing, sensitive data classification, or access control, and can hold a client to account on making data auditable and secure
  • Cost-conscious: optimised warehouse spend, storage strategies, or job efficiency, and treat compute as a resource to manage, not ignore
  • Platform fluency: worked across orchestration (Airflow, Dagster), warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks), ingestion (Fivetran, Airbyte, custom), and transformation (dbt, Spark)
  • AI Native: experienced in agentic coding workflows (context, harness, loop, and graph engineering), and able to embed AI Engineering constructs into pipelines (RAG, semantic search, evals, guardrails, etc)

You should apply if:

  • Confident and credible in front of clients and prospects, without needing a script, and comfortable holding a firm technical or commercial line when a client or prospect pushes back
  • Still able to hold up in a deep technical review today, architecture, data modelling, pipeline design, not just talk about decisions you made a few years ago
  • Self-motivated, and want to own building a practice, not just execute a workstream someone else has defined, and comfortable without a fully defined remit from day one
  • Able to work well with commercial and client services colleagues who aren't technical themselves, translating for them without talking down
  • Genuinely energised by variety: different clients, different stacks, different problems, rather than depth in one domain
  • Happy travelling regularly, client sites, workshops, industry events, wherever the work and the relationship-building actually happens

Propr.xyz is building a new Operating System for prop firms, helping them leverage blockchain technology to make them more efficient. We enable prop firms to leverage perpetual futures on Hyperliquid, prediction markets, and spot assets. We are actively deploying our technologies to the largest prop firms in the world. The pace is intense, but the journey is exciting. We only hire A-players. You need to be exceptional.

Responsibilities
Build the affiliate program from where it is today into a real revenue line: recruit, onboard, and grow a roster of affiliates (creators, finance/trading content sites, prop-firm comparison sites, PPC affiliates, X/Discord/Telegram operators, sub-affiliate networks).

Negotiate commercial terms: rev-share vs CPA vs hybrid, cookie windows, payout schedules, reporting cadence. Set the defaults; carve exceptions where the math works.

Coordinate with marketing, content, and product on landing pages, creatives, tracking links, promo codes, and launch windows.

Spot fraud early: cookie stuffing, self-referrals, multi-accounting, blow-up farming. Get those affiliates off the program fast.

Compliance-aware: prop trading is a regulated grey zone in many markets. Keep affiliate copy and geo-targeting clean.

Drive CAC down while scaling attributable revenue month-over-month.

Requirements
3+ years running affiliate marketing as the program owner (not just executing, building it).

Track record in web2. SaaS, fintech, online gambling/sports betting, forex/CFD brokers, crypto exchanges, anything with a real affiliate program at scale.

Numerate. Comfortable with LTV, CAC, payback period, blended ROI, attribution windows. Can read a SQL-style report and tell us which lever to pull.

Negotiated rev-share / CPA deals. Knows the going rates in the space and doesn't get cooked at the table.

Hands-on with at least one tracking platform (Tune, Affise, Everflow, Cellxpert, Post Affiliate Pro, or rolled-your-own).

Fluent written English. You'll be drafting partner comms, contracts, and dispute replies daily.

Bonus
Existing relationships in the trading / prop-firm / brokerage affiliate world.

Experience with crypto payouts (USDC, on-chain rails) and the operational hygiene that comes with them.

Worked alongside engineering before to spec attribution / postback / S2S tracking changes. You'll do that here.

Comfortable in X, Discord, and Telegram; that's where a lot of our partners actually live.

How to apply
We ask candidates to submit their application via a POST request to our API. This helps us identify candidates who read job descriptions carefully and have basic technical skills.

POST

https://propr.xyz/api/hiring/apply

{
"roleSlug": "affiliate-manager",

"link": "https://linkedin.com/in/yourprofile",
"coverNote": "Why Propr?",
"exceptionalNote": "What makes you exceptional at affiliate marketing?",

"appUid": "optional-trading-terminal-uid"
}

Responsibilities
Support and enhance the real-time risk engine processing 10k+ position updates/second across perpetuals, spots, and prediction markets.

Design and implement risk metrics: portfolio VaR, stress VaR, expected shortfall, Greeks aggregation, cross-asset correlations.

Build position limit frameworks: notional caps, delta limits, concentration limits, leverage constraints, drawdown thresholds.

Develop statistical models for tail-risk scenarios: fat-tailed distributions, regime switching, correlation breakdowns.

Implement margin calculation engines: cross-margining logic, liquidation price models, maintenance margin monitoring.

Work closely with trading infrastructure team to ensure <50ms P99 latency for risk calculations on critical paths.

Create real-time dashboards and alerting systems: exposure heatmaps, PnL attribution, limit breaches, anomaly detection.

Backtest risk models against historical liquidation events and high-volatility periods to validate accuracy.

Design circuit breakers and kill switches for extreme market conditions or system anomalies.

Requirements
3+ years of experience in quantitative risk, trading systems, or financial engineering.

Strong foundation in statistics, probability theory, and risk modeling (VaR, CVaR, ES, stress testing).

Proficiency in Python with NumPy, Pandas, SciPy for quantitative analysis and backtesting.

Experience with real-time risk systems processing 1000+ updates/second with <50ms latency.

Deep understanding of derivatives pricing: perpetual funding rates, mark-to-market, liquidation mechanics.

Portfolio risk metrics: Greeks (delta, gamma, vega), correlation matrices, beta hedging, tail risk.

Experience with crypto perpetuals (funding rates, cross-margining, liquidation cascades).

Familiarity with prediction markets (AMM mechanics, Kelly criterion, order book dynamics).

Time-series analysis: volatility modeling (GARCH, EWMA), regime detection, autocorrelation.

SQL proficiency for risk aggregation queries across millions of position updates.

Ability to translate complex risk concepts into real-time monitoring systems.

Understanding of margin calculations, position sizing, and drawdown controls.

Bonus
Experience with Hyperliquid API (WebSocket feeds, vault risk monitoring, liquidation engine).

Background in prop trading, market making, or hedge fund risk management (2-sigma+ shops preferred).

Knowledge of blockchain-specific risks: oracle failures, MEV, liquidation cascades, network congestion.

Proficiency with TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS for building production risk services.

Experience with event-driven architectures, message queues (Redis Streams, Kafka), CQRS patterns.

Time-series databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB) for storing tick-level risk snapshots.

Machine learning for anomaly detection: isolation forests, autoencoders, change point detection.

Understanding of regulatory frameworks (CFTC, SEC, MiFID II) and compliance monitoring.

Experience with Monte Carlo simulations, copula models, or extreme value theory.

Published research or contributions to quantitative finance / risk management literature.

DevOps: Docker, AWS (ECS, Aurora), Terraform, monitoring tools (Grafana, Datadog).

About Welo Global
Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com

The Role
We are seeking an experienced English into Ukrainian Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client.
You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content.
Project Details
- Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Ukrainian
What You Will Do
-Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.
What You Will Own
-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking
Requirements
- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI)
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
- Language: Native-level Ukrainian and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools
Additional Key Information
- Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work.
- A background check is required as part of onboarding.
- Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries.
Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam.
Why Join Us
This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing upskilling, and access to established linguistic resources.
If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global

We are seeking a Prompt Engineer to be responsible for the end-to-end technical migration workflow for transitioning templates to LLM autoraters. The role is required to use client’s internal tools to leverage prompt engineering techniques to maximize model performance.

Utilize Automatic Prompt Generation (APG) tools to create baseline prompts for complex parent-child template clusters.

Run and supervise Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) tool, review the outputs, and flag when the APO reaches deadlocks or plateaus.

Draft technical launch readiness justifications (Launch Certification Documentation) for final.

Linguistic expertise, including an understanding of semantics and logic.

About the Project
Project Hydrus is a scripted and conversational audio data collection project. The recordings produced help build natural, everyday-sounding synthesized voices for conversational AI products — voices that sound like real people talking, not scripted performances.
As Session Director, you'll lead live recording sessions with Voice Contributors, guiding them through scripted scenarios to produce natural, conversational-quality audio. This hands-on role blends creative direction, coaching, and technical audio judgment — making scripted material sound authentic and unscripted, rather than recited, while keeping sessions moving at a natural pace.
What You'll Do
- Direct voice performers through scripted scenarios, coaching for natural, conversational delivery rather than verbatim recitation.
- Build quick scene context for performers (who, where, why) and improvise to fill narrative or dialogue gaps live, keeping sessions flowing naturally.
- Adapt scripted wording for natural phrasing and regional/dialect authenticity as needed.
- Monitor and correct technical audio quality in real time: mic technique, pacing, clarity, and background noise.
- Manage session pacing to meet recording targets without sacrificing performance quality, and maintain organized notes on adjustments and retakes.
- Create a supportive, low-pressure environment for performers, including those with limited prior voice experience.
What We're Looking For
Required
- Native fluency in the required language (with specific dialect), with a strong ear for natural, colloquial phrasing.
- Experience directing, coaching, or producing voice or audio talent (e.g., voice direction, casting direction, audio/podcast production, dubbing/ADR, or theater direction).
- Demonstrated ability to give clear, specific, actionable performance direction.
- Strong working knowledge of basic recording/mic technique (proximity, plosives, room noise, levels).
- Comfortable improvising and adjusting scripted material on the spot.
- Excellent interpersonal skills; able to build rapport quickly with performers of varying experience levels.
Preferred (nice to have, not required)
- Background in improv, theater direction, or acting coaching.
- Experience directing non-professional or first-time voice talent specifically.
- Familiarity with DAWs or recording software (e.g., Pro Tools, Adobe Audition, Reaper) for spot-checking audio quality.

Commitment & Compensation
- Estimated time: Approximately 8 hours calibration, plus supervision across two recording sessions of ~4 hours each per participant

About Welo Global
Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com

The Role
We are seeking an experienced English into Armenian Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client.
You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content.
Project Details
- Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Armenian
What You Will Do
-Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.
What You Will Own
-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking
Requirements
- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping
- Style guide and expectation analysis: Ability to analyse style guide changes, identify implicit client expectations, and map tolerance by content type (for example, Marketing vs. Legal vs. UI)
- Meeting facilitation: Hands-on experience with one-to-one coaching, shadowing sessions, alignment roundtables, and structured monthly quality reporting
- Analytical approach: Skill in tracking error concentrations, severity drift, and alignment scores, and in converting justification patterns into style guide improvements
- Language: Native-level Armenian and professional-level English
- Preferred: Prior experience supporting major technology localization programs and working with calibration or alignment tools
Additional Key Information
- Successful candidates will be provided with a dedicated device for project work.
- A background check is required as part of onboarding.
- Candidates must be physically located in one of the approved countries.
Approved countries: Argentina, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Colombia, Costa Rica, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Egypt, El Salvador, Finland, France, Germany, Ghana, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Kenya, Lithuania, Malaysia, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Nigeria, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Qatar, Romania, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States and Vietnam.
Why Join Us
This role offers a long-term partnership with global teams on high-visibility products. You will benefit from steady project volume, comprehensive onboarding and ongoing upskilling, and access to established linguistic resources.
If this sounds like the right opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for a Slovak Localization QA Tester / Proofreader to join a long-term.

As a Linguistic Tester, you’ll help bring high-quality Slovak content to life and ensure it feels natural, accurate, and polished for end users. Your main focus will be reviewing and refining localized content, making sure it reads smoothly and is free from errors. This includes checking grammar, spelling, punctuation, consistency, formatting, and cultural or contextual accuracy.

You’ll also work hands-on with products by executing test cases, identifying localization bugs, and reporting issues through internal bug-tracking systems. Once fixes are implemented, you’ll help verify that they’ve been resolved correctly. From time to time, you’ll also have the opportunity to translate content from English into Slovak. In addition, you’ll explore user interfaces to identify localization or functional issues, playing an important role in delivering a seamless and user-friendly experience.

This role is ideal for someone with native-level Slovak fluency, strong attention to detail, and an interest in quality assurance within digital products. If you’re looking for a role where you can apply both your language expertise and technical skills, this is a great opportunity.

MAIN DUTIES

- Write and report relevant bugs and errors using best practices through the internal database system.
- Ability to understand and prioritize tasks and issues quickly and efficiently.
- Native language skills and cultural awareness of Slovak and Slovakia.
- Good oral and written communication.
- Highly organized with attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
- QA various products by accurately following testing instructions and test cases.
- Discover and report defects (bugs) using client-specific bug-tracking tools.
- Evaluate translations in the context of software, mobile apps, and documentation.
- Be a subject matter expert for linguistic issues in Slovak ; be able to research and resolve linguistic questions.
- Adhere to project-specific quality standards, trademarks, style guides, and client-preferred checklists and glossaries.
- Troubleshoot basic problems; be able to communicate effectively and escalate testing issues.
- Complete assigned tasks in a quality and timely manner.

IDEAL BACKGROUNDS: Marketing, Journalism, Copy Editing, Proofreading, Writing, Translation, and/or Localization

COMPENSATION: $24

Work arrangement: Hybrid – primarily remote, with approximately 10% on-site presence.

We are seeking a Prompt Engineer to be responsible for the end-to-end technical migration workflow for transitioning templates to LLM autoraters. The role is required to use client’s internal tools to leverage prompt engineering techniques to maximize model performance.

Responsibilities:
Utilize Automatic Prompt Generation (APG) tools to create baseline prompts for complex parent-child template clusters.

Run and supervise Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) tool, review the outputs, and flag when the APO reaches deadlocks or plateaus.

Manually draft, test, and refine prompts to navigate complex template architectures, overcome anti-patterns, and handle edge cases where tooling is lacking or broken. Solve edge-case scenarios by designing and refining manual prompts.

Monitor shadowbot runs to ensure sufficient disagreements (between human and LLM ratings) are registered, generated, and tracked.

Run prompt versions against established gold data to continuously measure autorater quality against the human crowd baseline, calculating accuracy metrics such as F1 scores, precision, and recall.

Draft technical launch readiness justifications (Launch Certification Documentation) for final.

Requirement:
Language Skills: Native fluency in German and fluent in English.

Location: Must be based in Germany.

Education: Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Doctorate degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Linguistics, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Cognitive Science, or a related analytical field.

Prompt Engineering & AI Expertise: At least 4 years' experience as Prompt Engineer. Proven experience tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) for strict, structured outputs, complex classification tasks, and familiarity with chain-of-thought and few-shot learning.

Data Analysis: Strong proficiency in identifying error patterns, analyzing model performance, and using SQL or other data analytics tools.

Technical Agility: Ability to quickly learn and master proprietary tools with minimal supervision.

Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Optional / Preferred Skills:
Familiarity with enterprise-grade LLM interfaces like the Goose API.

Experience in AI model evaluation, data science, computational linguistics, or software engineering.

Hands-on experience with Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) systems or tuning workflows.

Linguistic expertise, including an understanding of semantics and logic.

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.

Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com

Job Reference: #LI-JC1
ROLE OVERVIEW
The Software Development Engineer plays a pivotal role in the development of advanced information systems by deeply understanding business operations and translating them into scalable, maintainable, and efficient software solutions. This position requires a combination of technical expertise, creativity, and a collaborative approach to ensure that software components meet both current business needs and future growth. By analyzing operational requirements, the Software Development Engineer will design and implement complex software components, focusing on quality, performance, and long-term system sustainability.
In this role, the Software Development Engineer works closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, quality assurance, and technical leads, to ensure the seamless integration of solutions across different systems. They are responsible for guiding the development process from concept to implementation, ensuring that software meets rigorous standards for security, reliability, and scalability. Additionally, they actively participate in code reviews, mentor junior engineers, and foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the development team.
This position requires a strategic thinker with a passion for technology, someone who can balance hands-on coding with architectural oversight and technical leadership. Through their expertise and proactive problem-solving, the Software Engineer will contribute to the success of the team while working with SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and the overall organization by delivering high-quality software that drives business results.

Design and develop scalable applications focusing on high availability, fault tolerance, and performance optimization, while collaborating with DevOps teams to ensure smooth deployment and continuous delivery.
Implement and maintain RESTful APIs while working with SQL (MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB), with expertise in writing and optimizing complex queries.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to software engineers, ensuring adherence to best practices and architectural standards.
Collaborate with stakeholders to analyze requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deliver high-quality solutions aligned with business objectives.
Demonstrate expertise in system design, architecture, and optimization of complex systems, ensuring scalability and maintainability.
Quickly understand and adapt to existing system design and architecture to drive solutions that integrate seamlessly within established frameworks.
Optimize and fine-tune existing solutions for enhanced performance and operational efficiency.
Provide robust solutions for complex XML parsing and integrating third-party systems into the application ecosystem.
Architect systems using strong system design principles, incorporating security best practices, and demonstrating proficiency in OAuth 2.0 for authentication and authorization.
Leverage domain expertise in localization to deliver tailored solutions that meet industry-specific requirements.
Foster effective cross-team communication to align technical strategies with business goals and ensure smooth collaboration across departments.
Proven experience in full-stack development, with a deep understanding of front-end, back-end, and cloud technologies.
REQUIREMENTS
Education Level
Post-secondary degree in Computer Science or equivalent professional experience.
Experience
Demonstrable professional experience as the technical owner of major components or subsystems through the software development lifecycle.
Hands-on knowledge of AI-assisted coding tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) and a good understanding of prompt engineering, token optimization, and efficient token usage to improve development productivity and code quality.
Previous professional experience collaborating with business stakeholders.
Experience shipping code in an agile SDLC.
Previous experience in performance analysis and benchmarking.
Able to apply continuous integration, development, and automated testing concepts.
Knowledge of multiple frameworks, paradigms, languages, and trends in the relevant domain.
Technical Skills
Programming & Frameworks:Expertise in JavaScript, NodeJS, React, Vue.js, Go, Python.
Should be technology-agnostic, adaptable to different technology stacks, programming languages, frameworks, and tools.
Cloud & DevOps: Expertise in AWS, Azure, Docker, Git, CI/CD Pipelines.

We are seeking a Prompt Engineer to be responsible for the end-to-end technical migration workflow for transitioning templates to LLM autoraters. The role is required to use client’s internal tools to leverage prompt engineering techniques to maximize model performance.

Responsibilities:
Utilize Automatic Prompt Generation (APG) tools to create baseline prompts for complex parent-child template clusters.

Run and supervise Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) tool, review the outputs, and flag when the APO reaches deadlocks or plateaus.

Manually draft, test, and refine prompts to navigate complex template architectures, overcome anti-patterns, and handle edge cases where tooling is lacking or broken. Solve edge-case scenarios by designing and refining manual prompts.

Monitor shadowbot runs to ensure sufficient disagreements (between human and LLM ratings) are registered, generated, and tracked.

Run prompt versions against established gold data to continuously measure autorater quality against the human crowd baseline, calculating accuracy metrics such as F1 scores, precision, and recall.

Draft technical launch readiness justifications (Launch Certification Documentation) for final.

Requirement:
Language Skills: Native fluency in Portuguese and fluent in English.

Location: Must be based in Portugal.

Education: Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Doctorate degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Linguistics, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Cognitive Science, or a related analytical field.

Prompt Engineering & AI Expertise: At least 4 years' experience as Prompt Engineer. Proven experience tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) for strict, structured outputs, complex classification tasks, and familiarity with chain-of-thought and few-shot learning.

Data Analysis: Strong proficiency in identifying error patterns, analyzing model performance, and using SQL or other data analytics tools.

Technical Agility: Ability to quickly learn and master proprietary tools with minimal supervision.

Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Optional / Preferred Skills:
Familiarity with enterprise-grade LLM interfaces like the Goose API.

Experience in AI model evaluation, data science, computational linguistics, or software engineering.

Hands-on experience with Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) systems or tuning workflows.

Linguistic expertise, including an understanding of semantics and logic.

About Welocalize
Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.

Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com

Job Overview
Want to help bring a world-class digital product to audiences around the globe? As a Production Coordinator on our client’s Localization team, you’ll support the localization of product features, marketing campaigns, editorial content, and web experiences across multiple markets. You’ll work alongside Senior Coordinators and Project Managers to deliver high-quality work on time, while building your expertise in localization operations and cross-functional collaboration.
This role is built to grow. The localization function is shifting toward AI-first workflows, and over the next 12 months you’ll move from supported operational work toward independently running AI-assisted localization workflows. You’ll run traditional processes while building the skills to be the human judgment layer for AI output, and you’ll take on greater cross-functional ownership along the way. We’re hiring for today’s work and for where this role is heading.
Main Responsibilities
Facilitate the end-to-end localization workflow for product features, marketing campaigns, editorial, and web content, with guidance from Senior Coordinators or Project Managers
Work with designers, product owners, engineers, marketers, and internal reviewers to gather localization requirements and track open action items
Collaborate with external vendors on query management, file handoffs, and delivery timelines
Monitor project status and flag risks or blockers to stakeholders early
Manage day-to-day translation operations, including testing, bug triage, localizability reviews, and design audits
Help prioritize and balance incoming work across shifting priorities
Follow established translation workflows and contribute ideas to improve efficiency and reduce time to market
Use AI tools and automation to streamline repetitive tasks, and look for new ways to apply them as your skills grow
Assist with project retrospectives, internal reports, and presentations
Support new team members by sharing knowledge and documenting processes
Partner with Project Managers and Program Managers to make sure program operations align with business needs and localization best practices
Job Requirements
Clear, proactive communication: you’re comfortable asking questions and raising issues early
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a knack for keeping multiple workstreams on track
Comfort with change and ambiguity: you’d rather figure it out than wait for perfect instructions
Ownership of your work, and the discipline to follow through
Enthusiasm for AI and automation. The mindset matters more than prior experience
Skills & Experience
Curiosity and self-drive: when you meet a new tool or process, you dig in rather than wait to be shown
The ability to build strong working relationships through empathy, respect, and reliability
Experience in project coordination, localization operations, or a similar role is helpful, but not required if you bring the right mindset
A willingness to keep growing as your role expands
Education
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
Join us and help bring great digital experiences to every audience, in every language. You’ll learn quickly, take on more every month, and help shape how AI-first localization works. month, and help shape how AI-first localization works.

Job Reference: #LI-JC1

Ability to manage time effectively and maintain steady output

Willingness to ask questions and escalate when needed

Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (eligibility applies)

Unique campus features depending on location

The Quality Manager is the squad team member on a squad (s) responsible for supplier alignment and supplier performance on accounts owned by that squad. Experience in QC/QA for text classification, query annotation, data labeling, or search quality evaluation.

We are seeking a Prompt Engineer to be responsible for the end-to-end technical migration workflow for transitioning templates to LLM autoraters. The role is required to use client’s internal tools to leverage prompt engineering techniques to maximize model performance.

Responsibilities:
Utilize Automatic Prompt Generation (APG) tools to create baseline prompts for complex parent-child template clusters.

Run and supervise Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) tool, review the outputs, and flag when the APO reaches deadlocks or plateaus.

Manually draft, test, and refine prompts to navigate complex template architectures, overcome anti-patterns, and handle edge cases where tooling is lacking or broken. Solve edge-case scenarios by designing and refining manual prompts.

Monitor shadowbot runs to ensure sufficient disagreements (between human and LLM ratings) are registered, generated, and tracked.

Run prompt versions against established gold data to continuously measure autorater quality against the human crowd baseline, calculating accuracy metrics such as F1 scores, precision, and recall.

Draft technical launch readiness justifications (Launch Certification Documentation) for final.

Requirement:
Language Skills: Native fluency in Dutch and fluent in English.

Location: Must be based in Netherlands.

Education: Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Doctorate degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Linguistics, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Cognitive Science, or a related analytical field.

Prompt Engineering & AI Expertise: At least 4 years' experience as Prompt Engineer. Proven experience tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) for strict, structured outputs, complex classification tasks, and familiarity with chain-of-thought and few-shot learning.

Data Analysis: Strong proficiency in identifying error patterns, analyzing model performance, and using SQL or other data analytics tools.

Technical Agility: Ability to quickly learn and master proprietary tools with minimal supervision.

Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Optional / Preferred Skills:
Familiarity with enterprise-grade LLM interfaces like the Goose API.

Experience in AI model evaluation, data science, computational linguistics, or software engineering.

Hands-on experience with Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) systems or tuning workflows.

Linguistic expertise, including an understanding of semantics and logic.

Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. Quick overview of the project: In the initial phase, linguists are writing original reasoning prompts in the target language, the kind a smart native speaker can solve, but current AI models cannot. These fall into three categories:
Linguistic reasoning (grammar/structure puzzles)
Cultural reasoning (including culturally grounded math)
Wordplay/riddles.
Each completed item includes a native-language prompt, gold answer, rationale, English translation, and a difficulty rating.
What the Quality assurance work involves:
You will be responsible for reviewing and validating these completed prompts to ensure high quality and accuracy.
Task: QA / Review of reasoning prompts
Estimated effort: maximum 60 hours of work (from 10 to 30 mins per prompt Quality Check, total number of prompts to check 275 to be shared with another reviewer)
Reviewer expertise: Senior level
Deadline: End of year
